1.30.s:
tato brahmādayo devā dakṣaścaiva prajāpatiḥ.
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kathyatāṃ ko bhavāniti .. 30.161 ..
1.30.d:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवा दक्षश्चैव प्रजापतिः।
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा कथ्यतां को भवानिति ॥ 30.161 ॥
1.30.m: Then the gods headed by Brahmā, and Dakṣa Prajāpati, / folded their hands and said: “Tell us, who are you?”

1.30.s: ..vīrabhadra uvāca..
1.30.d: ॥वीरभद्र उवाच॥
1.30.m:
Vīrabhadra said:
I am neither a god nor an Āditya, nor have I come here to eat, / nor indeed to see the lords of the gods, nor out of curiosity.

1.30.s:
na ca devo na cādityo na ca bhoktumihāgataḥ.
naivadraṣṭuṃ hi devendrānna ca kautūhalānvitaḥ .. 30.162 ..
1.30.d:
न च देवो न चादित्यो न च भोक्तुमिहागतः।
नैवद्रष्टुं हि देवेन्द्रान्न च कौतूहलान्वितः ॥ 30.162 ॥

1.30.s:
dakṣayajñavināśārthaṃ samprāptaṃ viddhi māmiha.
vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ rudrakopādvinirgatam .. 30.163 ..
1.30.d:
दक्षयज्ञविनाशार्थं सम्प्राप्तं विद्धि मामिह।
वीरभद्र इति ख्यातं रुद्रकोपाद्विनिर्गतम् ॥ 30.163 ॥
1.30.m: Know that I have come here to destroy the sacrifice of Dakṣa, / known as Vīrabhadra, sprung from the wrath of Rudra.

1.30.s:
bhadrakālī ca vijñeyā devyāḥ krodhādvinirgatā.
preṣitā devadevena yajñāntikamihāgatā .. 30.164 ..
1.30.d:
भद्रकाली च विज्ञेया देव्याः क्रोधाद्विनिर्गता।
प्रेषिता देवदेवेन यज्ञान्तिकमिहागता ॥ 30.164 ॥
1.30.m: And she should be known as Bhadrakālī, sprung from the anger of the Goddess; / sent by the God of gods, she has come here to the vicinity of the sacrifice.

1.30.s:
śāraṇaṃ gaccha rājendra devaṃ te tvamumāpatim.
varaṃ krodho'pi rudrasya varadānaṃ na devataḥ .. 30.165 ..
1.30.d:
शारणं गच्छ राजेन्द्र देवं ते त्वमुमापतिम्।
वरं क्रोधोऽपि रुद्रस्य वरदानं न देवतः ॥ 30.165 ॥
1.30.m: Go for refuge, O best of kings, to your god, the husband of Umā; / even Rudra’s anger is better than a boon granted by any other deity.”

1.30.s:
vīrabhadravacaḥ śrutvā dakṣo dharmmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ.
toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram .. 30.166 ..
1.30.d:
वीरभद्रवचः श्रुत्वा दक्षो धर्म्मभृतां वरः।
तोषयामास देवेशं शूलपाणिं महेश्वरम् ॥ 30.166 ॥
1.30.m: Hearing the words of Vīrabhadra, Dakṣa, the best of upholders of dharma, / propitiated the Lord of gods, the trident-bearing Maheśvara.

1.30.s:
praduṣṭe yajñavāde tu vidruteṣu dvijātiṣu.
tārāmṛgamaye dīpte raudre bhīmamahānale .. 30.167 ..
1.30.d:
प्रदुष्टे यज्ञवादे तु विद्रुतेषु द्विजातिषु।
तारामृगमये दीप्ते रौद्रे भीममहानले ॥ 30.167 ॥
1.30.m: When the sacrificial ritual was corrupted and the twice-born had fled, / in the blazing, terrible, great fire of Rudra consisting of the constellation Mṛgaṣīrṣa,

1.30.s:
śūlanirbhinnavadanaiḥ kūjadbhiḥ paricārakaiḥ.
nikhātotpāṭitairyūpairapaviddhai ryyatastataḥ .. 30.168 ..
1.30.d:
शूलनिर्भिन्नवदनैः कूजद्भिः परिचारकैः।
निखातोत्पाटितैर्यूपैरपविद्धै र्य्यतस्ततः ॥ 30.168 ॥
1.30.m: with servants crying out, their faces pierced by tridents, / with sacrificial posts dug up, torn out, and scattered here and there,

1.30.s:
utpatdbhiḥ patadbhiśca gṛdhrairāmiṣagṛdhrubhiḥ.
pakṣapātavinirdhūtaiḥ śivāśatanināditaiḥ .. 30.169 ..
1.30.d:
उत्पत्द्भिः पतद्भिश्च गृध्रैरामिषगृध्रुभिः।
पक्षपातविनिर्धूतैः शिवाशतनिनादितैः ॥ 30.169 ॥
1.30.m: with vultures, eager for flesh, soaring and swooping down, / shaken by the flap of wings, resounding with hundreds of jackals—

1.30.s:
prāṇāpānau sannirudhya tataḥ sthānena yatnataḥ.
vicārya sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ bahudṛṣṭiramitrajit .. 30.170 ..
1.30.d:
प्राणापानौ सन्निरुध्य ततः स्थानेन यत्नतः।
विचार्य सर्वतो दृष्टिं बहुदृष्टिरमित्रजित् ॥ 30.170 ॥
1.30.m: then [Dakṣa], the conqueror of foes, having many sights, holding back the in-breath and out-breath / with effort from his place, casting his gaze everywhere,

1.30.s:
sahasā devadeveśaḥ agnikuṇḍādupāgataḥ.
candrasūryyasahasrasya tejaḥ saṃvarttakopamam .. 30.171 ..
1.30.d:
सहसा देवदेवेशः अग्निकुण्डादुपागतः।
चन्द्रसूर्य्यसहस्रस्य तेजः संवर्त्तकोपमम् ॥ 30.171 ॥
1.30.m: suddenly the lord of the gods of gods emerged from the fire pit, / possessing splendour like a thousand suns and moons, resembling the dissolution fire.

1.30.s:
prahasya cainaṃ bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt.
naṣṭaste jñānato dakṣa prītiste mayi sāṃpratam .. 30.172 ..
1.30.d:
प्रहस्य चैनं भगवानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
नष्टस्ते ज्ञानतो दक्ष प्रीतिस्ते मयि सांप्रतम् ॥ 30.172 ॥
1.30.m: Laughing, the Blessed Lord said these words to him: / "Your [delusion] has perished through knowledge, Dakṣa; your love now rests in me."

1.30.s:
smitaṃ kṛtvābravīdvākyaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te.
śrāvitañca samākhyāya devānāṃ gurubhiḥ saha .. 30.173 ..
1.30.d:
स्मितं कृत्वाब्रवीद्वाक्यं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते।
श्रावितञ्च समाख्याय देवानां गुरुभिः सह ॥ 30.173 ॥
1.30.m: Smiling, he spoke these words: "Speak, what may I do for you?" / Having proclaimed it, he made it heard together with the teachers of the gods.

1.30.s:
tamuvācāñjaliṃ kṛtvā dakṣo devaṃ prajāpatiḥ.
bhītaśaṅkitavitrastaḥ sabāṣpavadanekṣaṇaḥ .. 30.174 ..
1.30.d:
तमुवाचाञ्जलिं कृत्वा दक्षो देवं प्रजापतिः।
भीतशङ्कितवित्रस्तः सबाष्पवदनेक्षणः ॥ 30.174 ॥
1.30.m: Joining his palms, Prajāpati Dakṣa spoke to that god, / frightened, anxious, terrified, his face and eyes filled with tears:

1.30.s:
yadi prasanno bhagavān yadi vāhaṃ tava priyaḥ.
yadi vāhamanugrāhyo yadi deyo varo mama .. 30.175 ..
1.30.d:
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान् यदि वाहं तव प्रियः।
यदि वाहमनुग्राह्यो यदि देयो वरो मम ॥ 30.175 ॥
1.30.m: "If the Blessed Lord is pleased, or if I am dear to you, / or if I am worthy of grace, if a boon is to be granted to me:

1.30.s:
yajjagdhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ pītamaśitaṃ yacca nāśitam.
cūrṇīkṛtañjāpaviddhaṃ yajñasambhāramīdṛśam .. 30.176 ..
1.30.d:
यज्जग्धं भक्षितं पीतमशितं यच्च नाशितम्।
चूर्णीकृतञ्जापविद्धं यज्ञसम्भारमीदृशम् ॥ 30.176 ॥
1.30.m: Whatever has been devoured, eaten, drunk, consumed, and what has been destroyed, / pulverized, or cast away, of such sacrificial equipment,

1.30.s:
dīrghakālena mahatā prayatnena ca sañcitam.
tanna mithyā bhavenmahyaṃ varametaṃ vṛṇomyaham .. 30.177 ..
1.30.d:
दीर्घकालेन महता प्रयत्नेन च सञ्चितम्।
तन्न मिथ्या भवेन्मह्यं वरमेतं वृणोम्यहम् ॥ 30.177 ॥
1.30.m: amassed over a long time and with great effort, / may that not be in vain for me: this is the boon I choose."

1.30.s:
tathāstvityāha bhagavān bhaganetrahayo haraḥ.
dharmādhyakṣaṃ mahādevaṃ tryakṣantaṃ vai prajāpatiḥ .. 30.178 ..
1.30.d:
तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् भगनेत्रहयो हरः।
धर्माध्यक्षं महादेवं त्र्यक्षन्तं वै प्रजापतिः ॥ 30.178 ॥
1.30.m: "So be it," said the Blessed Lord Hara, the slayer of Bhaga's eyes. / To that overseer of dharma, Mahādeva, the three-eyed one, indeed, Prajāpati [Dakṣa],

1.30.s:
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā dakṣo labdhvā bhavādvaram.
nāmnāmaṣṭasahasreṇa stutavān vṛṣabhadhvajam .. 30.179 ..
1.30.d:
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा दक्षो लब्ध्वा भवाद्वरम्।
नाम्नामष्टसहस्रेण स्तुतवान् वृषभध्वजम् ॥ 30.179 ॥
1.30.m: going down upon his knees to the ground, having received the boon from Bhava, / Dakṣa praised the bull-bannered lord with eight thousand names.

1.30.s: ..dakṣa uvāca..
1.30.d: ॥दक्ष उवाच॥
1.30.m:
Dakṣa said:
Salutations to you, O lord of the gods of gods, slayer of the armies of the enemies of the gods, / O chief of the gods, best of immortals, worshiped by gods and dānavas!

1.30.s:
namaste devadeveśa devāribalasūdana.
devendra hyamaraśreṣṭha devadānavapūjita .. 30.180 ..
1.30.d:
नमस्ते देवदेवेश देवारिबलसूदन।
देवेन्द्र ह्यमरश्रेष्ठ देवदानवपूजित ॥ 30.180 ॥

1.30.s:
sahasrākṣa virūpākṣa tryakṣa yakṣādhipapriya.
sarvataḥ pāṇipādastvaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukhaḥ.
sarvataḥ śrutimān loke sarvānāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi .. 30.181 ..
1.30.d:
सहस्राक्ष विरूपाक्ष त्र्यक्ष यक्षाधिपप्रिय।
सर्वतः पाणिपादस्त्वं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखः।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमान् लोके सर्वानावृत्य तिष्ठसि ॥ 30.181 ॥
1.30.m: Thousand-eyed one, diverse-eyed one, three-eyed one, beloved of the lord of the yakṣas! / Your hands and feet are everywhere; your eyes, heads, and faces are on all sides; / you have ears everywhere in the world, standing encompassing all.

1.30.s:
śaṅkukarṇa mahākarṇa kumbhakarṇārṇavālaya.
gajendrakarṇa gokarṇa pāṇikarṇa namo'stu te .. 30.182 ..
1.30.d:
शङ्कुकर्ण महाकर्ण कुम्भकर्णार्णवालय।
गजेन्द्रकर्ण गोकर्ण पाणिकर्ण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.182 ॥
1.30.m: Peg-eared one, large-eared one, Kumbhakarṇa, ocean-dwelling one! / Having ears like a lord of elephants, cow-eared one, hand-eared one, homage be to you!

1.30.s:
śatodara śatāvartta śatajihva śatānana.
gāyanti tvāṃ gāyatriṇo hyarccayanti tathārccinaḥ .. 30.183 ..
1.30.d:
शतोदर शतावर्त्त शतजिह्व शतानन।
गायन्ति त्वां गायत्रिणो ह्यर्च्चयन्ति तथार्च्चिनः ॥ 30.183 ॥
1.30.m: Hundred-bellied one, hundred-whirled one, hundred-tongued one, hundred-faced one! / The singers of the Gāyatrī sing of you, and the worshipers worship you.

1.30.s:
devadānavagoptā ca brahmā ca tvaṃ śatakratuḥ.
mūrttīśastvaṃ mahāmūrte samudrāmbu dharāya ca .. 30.184 ..
1.30.d:
देवदानवगोप्ता च ब्रह्मा च त्वं शतक्रतुः।
मूर्त्तीशस्त्वं महामूर्ते समुद्राम्बु धराय च ॥ 30.184 ॥
1.30.m: You are the protector of gods and dānavas, Brahmā, and Śatakratu. / You are the lord of manifestations, O one of great form, holding the waters of the ocean!

1.30.s:
sarvā hyasmin devatāste gāvo goṣṭha ivāsate.
śarīrante prapaśyāmi somamagniṃ jaleśvaram .. 30.185 ..
1.30.d:
सर्वा ह्यस्मिन् देवतास्ते गावो गोष्ठ इवासते।
शरीरन्ते प्रपश्यामि सोममग्निं जलेश्वरम् ॥ 30.185 ॥
1.30.m: All the deities dwell in you like cows in a cowpen. / In your body I behold Soma, Agni, the lord of waters [Varuṇa],

1.30.s:
ādityamatha viṣṇuñca brahmāṇaṃ sabṛhaspatim.
kriyā kāryyaṃ kāraṇañca karttā karaṇameva ca .. 30.186 ..
1.30.d:
आदित्यमथ विष्णुञ्च ब्रह्माणं सबृहस्पतिम्।
क्रिया कार्य्यं कारणञ्च कर्त्ता करणमेव च ॥ 30.186 ॥
1.30.m: Āditya, Viṣṇu, and Brahmā together with Bṛhaspati, / the rite, the effect, the cause, the agent, and the instrument,

1.30.s:
asacca sadasaccaiva tathaiva prabhavāvyayam.
namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca .. 30.187 ..
1.30.d:
असच्च सदसच्चैव तथैव प्रभवाव्ययम्।
नमो भवाय शर्वाय रुद्राय वरदाय च ॥ 30.187 ॥
1.30.m: the non-existent, the existent, the existent-non-existent, as well as the imperishable source of origin. / Homage to Bhava, Śarva, Rudra, and the giver of boons!

1.30.s:
paśūnāṃ pataye caiva namastvandhakaghātine.
trijaṭāya triśīrṣāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe .. 30.188 ..
1.30.d:
पशूनां पतये चैव नमस्त्वन्धकघातिने।
त्रिजटाय त्रिशीर्षाय त्रिशूलवरधारिणे ॥ 30.188 ॥
1.30.m: And homage to the lord of beasts, the slayer of Andhaka! / To the one with three matted locks, the three-headed one, the bearer of the excellent trident,

1.30.s:
tryambakāya trinetrāya tripuraghnāya vai namaḥ.
namaścaṇḍāya muṇḍāya pracaṇḍāya dharāya ca .. 30.189 ..
1.30.d:
त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिपुरघ्नाय वै नमः।
नमश्चण्डाय मुण्डाय प्रचण्डाय धराय च ॥ 30.189 ॥
1.30.m: to Tryambaka, the three-eyed one, to the destroyer of Tripura, homage indeed! / Homage to the fierce one, the shaven-headed one, the violent one, and the supporter!

1.30.s:
daṇḍi(?) māsaktakarṇāya daṇḍimuṇḍāya vai namaḥ.
namo'rddhadaṇḍakeśāya niṣkāya vikṛtāya ca .. 30.190 ..
1.30.d:
दण्डि(?) मासक्तकर्णाय दण्डिमुण्डाय वै नमः।
नमोऽर्द्धदण्डकेशाय निष्काय विकृताय च ॥ 30.190 ॥
1.30.m: […] with ears attached to a staff, homage indeed to the staff-bearer with a shaven head! / Homage to the one with hair half in the daṇḍaka style, the necklet-wearer, and the deformed one!

1.30.s:
vilohitāya dhūmrāya nālagrīvāya te namaḥ.
namastvapratirūpāya śivāya ca namo'stu te .. 30.191 ..
1.30.d:
विलोहिताय धूम्राय नालग्रीवाय ते नमः।
नमस्त्वप्रतिरूपाय शिवाय च नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.191 ॥
1.30.m: To the dark-red one, the smoky one, to the blue-throated one, homage to you! / Homage to the peerless one, and homage be to you, O Śiva!

1.30.s:
sūryyāya sūryyapataye sūryyadhvajapatākine.
namaḥ pramathanāthāya vṛṣaskandhāya dhanvine .. 30.192 ..
1.30.d:
सूर्य्याय सूर्य्यपतये सूर्य्यध्वजपताकिने।
नमः प्रमथनाथाय वृषस्कन्धाय धन्विने ॥ 30.192 ॥
1.30.m: To Sūrya, the lord of the sun, having the sun on your banner and flag! / Homage to the lord of the Pramathas, bull-shouldered one, bowman!

1.30.s:
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyakavacāya ca.
hiraṇyakṛtacūḍāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥ .. 30.193 ..
1.30.d:
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय हिरण्यकवचाय च।
हिरण्यकृतचूडाय हिरण्यपतये नमः ॥ 30.193 ॥
1.30.m: Homage to Hiraṇyagarbha, and to the golden-armoured one, / to the one with a crest of gold, homage to the lord of gold!

1.30.s:
satraghātāya daṇḍāya varṇapānapuṭāya ca.
namaḥ stutāya stutyāya stūyamānāya vai namaḥ .. 30.194 ..
1.30.d:
सत्रघाताय दण्डाय वर्णपानपुटाय च।
नमः स्तुताय स्तुत्याय स्तूयमानाय वै नमः ॥ 30.194 ॥
1.30.m: To the destroyer of the sacrificial session, the staff, the hollow hands drinking the syllables! / Homage to the praised one, the praiseworthy one, and indeed to the one being praised!

1.30.s:
sarvāyābhakṣyabhakṣyāya sarvabhūtānttarātmane.
namo hotrāya mantrāya śukladhvajapatākine .. 30.195 ..
1.30.d:
सर्वायाभक्ष्यभक्ष्याय सर्वभूतान्त्तरात्मने।
नमो होत्राय मन्त्राय शुक्लध्वजपताकिने ॥ 30.195 ॥
1.30.m: To Sarva, to the uneatable food, to the inner self of all beings! / Homage to the Hotṛ, to the mantra, to the one with white banners and flags!

1.30.s:
namo namāya namyāya namaḥ kilikilāya ca.
namaste śayamānāya śayitāyotthitāya ca .. 30.196 ..
1.30.d:
नमो नमाय नम्याय नमः किलिकिलाय च।
नमस्ते शयमानाय शयितायोत्थिताय च ॥ 30.196 ॥
1.30.m: Homage to reverence, to the one worthy of reverence, and homage to the sound 'kili-kili'! / Homage to you lying down, asleep, and arisen!

1.30.s:
sthitāya calamānāya mudrāya kuṭilāya ca.
napno narttanaśīlāya mukhavāditrakāriṇe .. 30.197 ..
1.30.d:
स्थिताय चलमानाय मुद्राय कुटिलाय च।
नप्नो नर्त्तनशीलाय मुखवादित्रकारिणे ॥ 30.197 ॥
1.30.m: To the standing, the moving, the seal, and the crooked! / Homage to the dancer, to the one who makes mouth-music!

1.30.s:
nāṭyopahāralubdhāya gītavādyaratāya ca.
namo jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya balapramathanāya ca .. 30.198 ..
1.30.d:
नाट्योपहारलुब्धाय गीतवाद्यरताय च।
नमो ज्येष्ठाय श्रेष्ठाय बलप्रमथनाय च ॥ 30.198 ॥
1.30.m: To the one greedy for theatrical offerings, fond of singing and instrumental music! / Homage to the eldest, the best, and the crusher of strength!

1.30.s:
kalanāya ca kalpāya kṣayāyopakṣayāya ca.
bhīmadundubhihāsāya bhīmasenapriyāya ca .. 30.199 ..
1.30.d:
कलनाय च कल्पाय क्षयायोपक्षयाय च।
भीमदुन्दुभिहासाय भीमसेनप्रियाय च ॥ 30.199 ॥
1.30.m: To the driving force, to the aeon, to destruction and secondary destruction! / To the one whose laughter is like a terrible drum, who is dear to Bhīmasena!

1.30.s:
ugrāya ca namo nityaṃ namaste daśabāhave.
namaḥ kapālahastāya citābhasmapriyāya ca .. 30.200 ..
1.30.d:
उग्राय च नमो नित्यं नमस्ते दशबाहवे।
नमः कपालहस्ताय चिताभस्मप्रियाय च ॥ 30.200 ॥
1.30.m: Homage always to the fierce one; homage to you, ten-armed one! / Homage to the one with a skull in his hand, fond of funeral-pyre ashes!

1.30.s:
vibhīṣaṇāya bhīṣmāya bhīṣmavratadharāya ca.
namo vikṛtavakṣāya khaḍgajihvāgradaṃṣṭriṇe .. 30.201 ..
1.30.d:
विभीषणाय भीष्माय भीष्मव्रतधराय च।
नमो विकृतवक्षाय खड्गजिह्वाग्रदंष्ट्रिणे ॥ 30.201 ॥
1.30.m: To the dreadful one, the terrifying one, the observer of terrible vows! / Homage to the deformed-chested one, with fangs and a sword-blade tongue!

1.30.s:
pakvāmamāṃsalubdhāya tumbavīṇāpriyāya ca.
namo vṛṣāya vṛṣyāya vṛṣṇaye vṛṣaṇāya ca .. 30.202 ..
1.30.d:
पक्वाममांसलुब्धाय तुम्बवीणाप्रियाय च।
नमो वृषाय वृष्याय वृष्णये वृषणाय च ॥ 30.202 ॥
1.30.m: To the one greedy for cooked and raw meat, fond of the gourd-lute! / Homage to the bull, the virile one, the showerer, the scrotal one!

1.30.s:
kaṭaṅkaṭāya caṇḍāya namaḥ sāvayavāya ca.
namaste varakṛṣṇāya varāya varadāya ca .. 30.203 ..
1.30.d:
कटङ्कटाय चण्डाय नमः सावयवाय च।
नमस्ते वरकृष्णाय वराय वरदाय च ॥ 30.203 ॥
1.30.m: To Kaṭaṅkaṭa, the wrathful one, and homage to the one with limbs! / Homage to you, the excellent dark one, the choice one, the giver of boons!

1.30.s:
varagandhamālyavastrāya varātivaraye namaḥ .
namo varṣāya vātāya chāyāyai ātapāya ca .. 30.204 ..
1.30.d:
वरगन्धमाल्यवस्त्राय वरातिवरये नमः ।
नमो वर्षाय वाताय छायायै आतपाय च ॥ 30.204 ॥
1.30.m: To the one with choice perfumes, garlands, and garments, homage to the boon beyond boons! / Homage to rain, to wind, to shade, and to blazing heat!

1.30.s:
namo raktaviraktāya śobhanāyākṣamāline.
sambhinnāya vibhānnāya viviktavikaṭāya ca .. 30.205 ..
1.30.d:
नमो रक्तविरक्ताय शोभनायाक्षमालिने।
सम्भिन्नाय विभान्नाय विविक्तविकटाय च ॥ 30.205 ॥
1.30.m: Homage to the impassioned and dispassioned, the splendid one, wearer of a rosary! / To the shattered, the fragmented, the secluded, and the formidable!

1.30.s:
aghorarūparūpāya ghoraghoratarāya ca .
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya namaḥ śāntatarāya ca .. 30.206 ..
1.30.d:
अघोररूपरूपाय घोरघोरतराय च ।
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय नमः शान्ततराय च ॥ 30.206 ॥
1.30.m: To the one whose form has a non-terrible form, and to the terrible and more terrible! / Homage to Śiva, the peaceful, and homage to the more peaceful!

1.30.s:
ekapādbahunetrāya ekaśīrṣannamo'stu te.
namo vṛddhāya lubdhāya saṃvibhāgapriyāya ca .. 30.207 ..
1.30.d:
एकपाद्बहुनेत्राय एकशीर्षन्नमोऽस्तु ते।
नमो वृद्धाय लुब्धाय संविभागप्रियाय च ॥ 30.207 ॥
1.30.m: O one-footed one of many eyes, one-headed one, homage be to you! / Homage to the aged one, the greedy one, and the one fond of sharing!

1.30.s:
pañcamālārcitāṅgāya namaḥ pāśupatāya ca.
namaścaṇḍāya ghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭayā jagdharandhriṇe .. 30.208 ..
1.30.d:
पञ्चमालार्चिताङ्गाय नमः पाशुपताय च।
नमश्चण्डाय घण्टाय घण्टया जग्धरन्ध्रिणे ॥ 30.208 ॥
1.30.m: To the one whose limbs are worshiped with five garlands, and homage to the lord of beasts! / Homage to the fierce one, the bell, to the one who consumed cavities through his bell!

1.30.s:
sahasaśataghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāmālāpriyāya ca.
prāṇadaṇḍāya tyāgāya namo hilihilāya ca .. 30.209 ..
1.30.d:
सहसशतघण्टाय घण्टामालाप्रियाय च।
प्राणदण्डाय त्यागाय नमो हिलिहिलाय च ॥ 30.209 ॥
1.30.m: To the one with thousands and hundreds of bells, fond of garlands of bells! / To the punisher of life-breath, to renunciation, and homage to the sound 'hili-hili'!

1.30.s:
hūṃhūṅkārāya pārāya hūṃhūṅkārapriyāya ca.
namaśca śambhave nityaṃ giri vṛkṣakalāya ca .. 30.210 ..
1.30.d:
हूंहूङ्काराय पाराय हूंहूङ्कारप्रियाय च।
नमश्च शम्भवे नित्यं गिरि वृक्षकलाय च ॥ 30.210 ॥
1.30.m: To the roar 'hūṃ-hūṃ', to the far shore, fond of the roar 'hūṃ-hūṃ'! / And homage always to Śambhu, residing in mountains and trees!

1.30.s:
garbhamāṃsaśrṛgālāya tārakāya tarāya ca .
namo yajñādhipataye drutāyopadrutāya ca .. 30.211 ..
1.30.d:
गर्भमांसश्रृगालाय तारकाय तराय च ।
नमो यज्ञाधिपतये द्रुतायोपद्रुताय च ॥ 30.211 ॥
1.30.m: To the jackal eating the flesh of embryos, the deliverer, and the one who crosses over! / Homage to the lord of the sacrifice, to the swift one, and to the assailed one!

1.30.s:
yajñavāhāya dānāya tapyāya tapanāya ca.
namastaṭāya bhavyāya taḍitāṃ pataye namaḥ .. 30.212 ..
1.30.d:
यज्ञवाहाय दानाय तप्याय तपनाय च।
नमस्तटाय भव्याय तडितां पतये नमः ॥ 30.212 ॥
1.30.m: To the bearer of sacrifice, to gift, to the one to be heated, and to the heater; / homage to the shore, to the auspicious, homage to the lord of lightning bolts.

1.30.s:
annadāyānnapataye namo'stvannabhavāya ca.
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣṇe ca sahasracaraṇāya ca .. 30.213 ..
1.30.d:
अन्नदायान्नपतये नमोऽस्त्वन्नभवाय च।
नमः सहस्रशीर्ष्णे च सहस्रचरणाय च ॥ 30.213 ॥
1.30.m: Homage to the giver of food, to the lord of food, and to the one born of food; / homage to the thousand-headed and thousand-footed one,

1.30.s:
sahasrodyataśūlāya sahasranayanāya ca.
namo'stu bālarūpāya bālarūpadharāya ca .. 30.214 ..
1.30.d:
सहस्रोद्यतशूलाय सहस्रनयनाय च।
नमोऽस्तु बालरूपाय बालरूपधराय च ॥ 30.214 ॥
1.30.m: To the one with a thousand raised tridents and a thousand eyes; / homage to the child-formed and the bearer of a child's form,

1.30.s:
bālānāñcaiva goptre ca bālakrīḍanakāya ca.
namaḥ śuddhāya buddhāya kṣobhaṇāyākṣatāya ca .. 30.215 ..
1.30.d:
बालानाञ्चैव गोप्त्रे च बालक्रीडनकाय च।
नमः शुद्धाय बुद्धाय क्षोभणायाक्षताय च ॥ 30.215 ॥
1.30.m: To the protector of children and the plaything of children; / homage to the pure, the awakened, the agitator, and the unhurt.

1.30.s:
taraṅgāṅkitakeśāya muktakeśāya vai namaḥ.
namaḥ ṣaṭkarmaniṣṭhāya trikarmaniratāya ca .. 30.216 ..
1.30.d:
तरङ्गाङ्कितकेशाय मुक्तकेशाय वै नमः।
नमः षट्कर्मनिष्ठाय त्रिकर्मनिरताय च ॥ 30.216 ॥
1.30.m: Homage indeed to the one whose hair is marked with waves, whose hair is unbound; / homage to the one devoted to the six duties, intent on the three duties,

1.30.s:
varṇāśramāṇāṃ vidhivat pṛthakkarmapravartine.
mano ghoṣāya ghoṣyāya namaḥ kalakalāya ca .. 30.217 ..
1.30.d:
वर्णाश्रमाणां विधिवत् पृथक्कर्मप्रवर्तिने।
मनो घोषाय घोष्याय नमः कलकलाय च ॥ 30.217 ॥
1.30.m: Who duly sets in motion the distinct duties of the classes and life-stages; / to the inner roar, to the one to be sounded, homage to the confused murmur,

1.30.s:
śvetapiṅgalanetrāya kṛṣṇaraktakṣaṇāya ca .
dharmārtha kāmamokṣāya krathāya kathanāya ca .. 30.218 ..
1.30.d:
श्वेतपिङ्गलनेत्राय कृष्णरक्तक्षणाय च ।
धर्मार्थ काममोक्षाय क्रथाय कथनाय च ॥ 30.218 ॥
1.30.m: To the one with white and reddish-brown eyes, with black and red eyes; / to dharma, profit, pleasure, and liberation, to the crusher and the narrator,

1.30.s:
sāṅkhyāya sāṅkhyamukhyāya yogādhipataye namaḥ.
namorathyavirathyāya catuṣpatharatāya ca .. 30.219 ..
1.30.d:
साङ्ख्याय साङ्ख्यमुख्याय योगाधिपतये नमः।
नमोरथ्यविरथ्याय चतुष्पथरताय च ॥ 30.219 ॥
1.30.m: To Sāṅkhya, to the foremost of Sāṅkhya, homage to the lord of yoga; / homage to the one who rides a chariot and walks on foot, delighting in crossroads,

1.30.s:
kṛṣṇā jinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine.
īśānavajrasaṃhāya harikeśa namo'stu te.
avivekaikanāthāya vyaktāvyakta namo'stu te .. 30.220 ..
1.30.d:
कृष्णा जिनोत्तरीयाय व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने।
ईशानवज्रसंहाय हरिकेश नमोऽस्तु ते।
अविवेकैकनाथाय व्यक्ताव्यक्त नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.220 ॥
1.30.m: Whose upper garment is a black buckskin, whose sacred thread is a snake, / equal to the thunderbolt of Īśāna, yellow-haired one, homage be to you; / sole protector of the undiscerning, manifest and unmanifest one, homage be to you.

1.30.s:
kāma kāmada kāmadhna dhṛṣṭodṛptaniṣūdana.
sarva sarvada sarvajña sandhyārāga namo'stu te .. 30.221 ..
1.30.d:
काम कामद कामध्न धृष्टोदृप्तनिषूदन।
सर्व सर्वद सर्वज्ञ सन्ध्याराग नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.221 ॥
1.30.m: Desire, giver of desire, slayer of desire, destroyer of the arrogant and insolent, / all, giver of all, all-knowing one, twilight glow, homage be to you.

1.30.s:
mahābāla mahābāho mahāsattva mahādyute.
mahāmeghavaraprekṣa mahākāla namo'stu te .. 30.222 ..
1.30.d:
महाबाल महाबाहो महासत्त्व महाद्युते।
महामेघवरप्रेक्ष महाकाल नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.222 ॥
1.30.m: O one of great strength, great-armed one, of great goodness, of great splendor, / with the gaze of an excellent great raincloud, Mahākāla, homage be to you.

1.30.s:
sthūlajīrṇaṇāṅgajaṭine valkalājinadhāriṇe.
dīptaśūryāgnijaṭine valkalājinavāsase.
sahasrasūryapratima taponitya namo'stu te .. 30.223 ..
1.30.d:
स्थूलजीर्णणाङ्गजटिने वल्कलाजिनधारिणे।
दीप्तशूर्याग्निजटिने वल्कलाजिनवाससे।
सहस्रसूर्यप्रतिम तपोनित्य नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.223 ॥
1.30.m: To the matted-haired one with large, aged limbs, wearing bark and deer-skin, / with matted locks like the blazing sun and fire, clothed in bark and deer-skin, / resembling a thousand suns, ever devoted to ascetic toil, homage be to you.

1.30.s:
unmādanaśatāvartta gaṅgātoyārddhamūrddhaja.
candrāvartta yugāvartta meghāvartta namo'stu te .. 30.224 ..
1.30.d:
उन्मादनशतावर्त्त गङ्गातोयार्द्धमूर्द्धज।
चन्द्रावर्त्त युगावर्त्त मेघावर्त्त नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 30.224 ॥
1.30.m: O one who maddens hundreds of times, having the hair on half your head wetted by Gaṅgā's water, / having the whirlpool of the moon, the turning of the yugas, the vortex of clouds, homage be to you.

1.30.s:
tvamannamannakarttā ca annadaśca tvameva hi.
annasraṣṭā ca paktā ca pakvabhuktapace namaḥ .. 30.225 ..
1.30.d:
त्वमन्नमन्नकर्त्ता च अन्नदश्च त्वमेव हि।
अन्नस्रष्टा च पक्ता च पक्वभुक्तपचे नमः ॥ 30.225 ॥
1.30.m: You are food and the maker of food, and you indeed are the giver of food; / the creator of food and the cooker; homage to you who digest what is cooked and eaten.

1.30.s:
jarāyujo'ṇḍajaścaiva svedajodbhijja eva ca.
tvameva devadevaśo bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ .. 30.226 .
carācarasya brahmā tvaṃ pratiharttā tvameva ca.
tvameva brahmaviduṣāmapi brahmavidāṃ varaḥ .. 30.227 ..
1.30.d:
जरायुजोऽण्डजश्चैव स्वेदजोद्भिज्ज एव च।
त्वमेव देवदेवशो भूतग्रामश्चतुर्विधः ॥ 30.226 ।
चराचरस्य ब्रह्मा त्वं प्रतिहर्त्ता त्वमेव च।
त्वमेव ब्रह्मविदुषामपि ब्रह्मविदां वरः ॥ 30.227 ॥
1.30.m: The womb-born, the egg-born, the sweat-born, and the sprout-born— / you alone, O god of gods, are the fourfold assemblage of beings. / You are the Brahmā of the moving and unmoving, and you alone are the withdrawer; / you alone are the foremost of knowers of Brahman even among those who know Brahman.

1.30.s:
sattvasya paramā yonirabvāyujyotiṣāṃ nidhiḥ.
ṛksāmani tathoṅkāramāhustvāṃ brahmavādinaḥ .. 30.228 ..
1.30.d:
सत्त्वस्य परमा योनिरब्वायुज्योतिषां निधिः।
ऋक्सामनि तथोङ्कारमाहुस्त्वां ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥ 30.228 ॥
1.30.m: You are the supreme source of being, the treasury of water, wind, and light; / the exponents of the Veda call you the Ṛg, the Sāman, and the sound Om.

1.30.s:
havirhāvī havo hāvī huvāṃ vācāhutiḥ sadā.
gāyanti tvāṃ suraśreṣṭha sāmagā brahmavādinaḥ .. 30.229 ..
1.30.d:
हविर्हावी हवो हावी हुवां वाचाहुतिः सदा।
गायन्ति त्वां सुरश्रेष्ठ सामगा ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥ 30.229 ॥
1.30.m: You are the oblation, the invoker, the call, the summoner, ever the offering through spoken speech; / the singers of the Sāman, exponents of the Veda, sing of you, O best of gods.

1.30.s:
yajurmayo ṛṅmayasva sāmātharvamayastathā.
paṭhyase brahmavidbhistvaṃ kalpopaniṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ .. 30.230 ..
1.30.d:
यजुर्मयो ऋङ्मयस्व सामाथर्वमयस्तथा।
पठ्यसे ब्रह्मविद्भिस्त्वं कल्पोपनिषदां गणैः ॥ 30.230 ॥
1.30.m: You consist of the Yajus, of the Ṛg, and likewise of the Sāman and the Atharvan; / you are recited by the knowers of Brahman along with the hosts of Kalpas and Upaniṣads.

1.30.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā varṇāvarāśca ye.
tvāmeva meghasaṅghāśca viśvasta nitagarjjitam .. 30.231 ..
1.30.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा वर्णावराश्च ये।
त्वामेव मेघसङ्घाश्च विश्वस्त नितगर्ज्जितम् ॥ 30.231 ॥
1.30.m: Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and those of lower classes, / and the masses of clouds, [praise] you whose roar is trusted by the universe.

1.30.s:
saṃvatsarastvamṛtavo māsā māsārddhameva ca.
kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣāśca nakṣatrāṇi yugā grahāḥ .. 30.232 ..
1.30.d:
संवत्सरस्त्वमृतवो मासा मासार्द्धमेव च।
कला काष्ठा निमेषाश्च नक्षत्राणि युगा ग्रहाः ॥ 30.232 ॥
1.30.m: You are the year, the seasons, the months, and the fortnights, / the kalās, the kāṣṭhās, the twinklings of the eye, the lunar mansions, the yugas, and the planets.

1.30.s:
vṛṣāṇāṃ kakudaṃ tvaṃ higirīṇāṃ śikharāṇi ca.
siṃho mṛgāṇāṃ patatāṃ tārkṣyo'nantaśca bhoginām .. 30.233 ..
1.30.d:
वृषाणां ककुदं त्वं हिगिरीणां शिखराणि च।
सिंहो मृगाणां पततां तार्क्ष्योऽनन्तश्च भोगिनाम् ॥ 30.233 ॥
1.30.m: You are the hump of bulls, the peaks of mountains, / the lion among beasts, Garuḍa among birds, and Ananta among serpents.

1.30.s:
kṣīrodo hyudadhīnāñca yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca.
vajrampraharaṇānāñca vratānāṃ satyameva ca .. 30.234 ..
1.30.d:
क्षीरोदो ह्युदधीनाञ्च यन्त्राणां धनुरेव च।
वज्रम्प्रहरणानाञ्च व्रतानां सत्यमेव च ॥ 30.234 ॥
1.30.m: The milk ocean among seas, the bow among mechanical engines, / the thunderbolt among weapons, and truth among vows.

1.30.s:
icchā dveṣaśca rāgaśca mohaḥ kṣāmo damaḥ śamaḥ.
vyavasāyo dhṛtirlobhaḥ kāmakrodhau jayājayau .. 30.235 ..
1.30.d:
इच्छा द्वेषश्च रागश्च मोहः क्षामो दमः शमः।
व्यवसायो धृतिर्लोभः कामक्रोधौ जयाजयौ ॥ 30.235 ॥
1.30.m: Desire and hatred, passion, delusion, forbearance, restraint, calm, / resolve, steadfastness, greed, lust and anger, victory and defeat.

1.30.s:
tvaṃ gadī tvaṃ śarī cāpi khaṭvāṅgī jharjharī tathā .
chettā bhettā praharttā ca tvaṃ netāpyantako mataḥ .. 30.236 ..
1.30.d:
त्वं गदी त्वं शरी चापि खट्वाङ्गी झर्झरी तथा ।
छेत्ता भेत्ता प्रहर्त्ता च त्वं नेताप्यन्तको मतः ॥ 30.236 ॥
1.30.m: You bear a mace, you bear an arrow, you carry a skull-topped staff and a jharjharī; / the cutter, the cleaver, the striker, the leader, and you are considered the Ender.

1.30.s:
daśalakṣaṇasaṃyukto dharmo'rthaḥ kāma eva .
indraḥ samudrāḥ saritaḥ palvalāni sarāṃsi ca .. 30.237 ..
1.30.d:
दशलक्षणसंयुक्तो धर्मोऽर्थः काम एव ।
इन्द्रः समुद्राः सरितः पल्वलानि सरांसि च ॥ 30.237 ॥
1.30.m: You are endowed with the ten characteristics of dharma, profit, and desire; / Indra, the oceans, the rivers, the pools, and the lakes.

1.30.s:
latāvallī tṛṇauṣadhyaḥ paśavo mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ.
dravyakarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālapuṣpaphalapradaḥ .. 30.238 ..
1.30.d:
लतावल्ली तृणौषध्यः पशवो मृगपक्षिणः।
द्रव्यकर्मगुणारम्भः कालपुष्पफलप्रदः ॥ 30.238 ॥
1.30.m: Creepers, vines, grasses, medicinal herbs, domestic beasts, wild animals, and birds; / the beginning of substances, actions, and qualities, the granter of the flowers and fruits of time.

1.30.s:
ādiśvāntaśca madhyaśca gāyatryoṅkāra eva ca.
harito lohitaḥ kṛṣṇo nīlaḥ pītastathāruṇaḥ .. 30.239 ..
1.30.d:
आदिश्वान्तश्च मध्यश्च गायत्र्योङ्कार एव च।
हरितो लोहितः कृष्णो नीलः पीतस्तथारुणः ॥ 30.239 ॥
1.30.m: The beginning, the end, and the middle, the Gāyatrī and the sound Om; / greenish, blood-red, black, dark blue, yellow, and tawny-red;

1.30.s:
kadruśca kapilaścaiva kapoto mecakastathā.
suvarṇaretā vikhyātaḥ suvarṇa ścāpyato mataḥ .. 30.240 ..
1.30.d:
कद्रुश्च कपिलश्चैव कपोतो मेचकस्तथा।
सुवर्णरेता विख्यातः सुवर्ण श्चाप्यतो मतः ॥ 30.240 ॥
1.30.m: Brown, tawny, dove-gray, and dark; / famed as golden-seedy, and therefore considered golden;

1.30.s:
suvarṇanāmā ca tathā suvarṇapriya eva ca.
tvamindro'tha yamaścaiva varuṇo dhanado'nalaḥ .. 30.241 ..
1.30.d:
सुवर्णनामा च तथा सुवर्णप्रिय एव च।
त्वमिन्द्रोऽथ यमश्चैव वरुणो धनदोऽनलः ॥ 30.241 ॥
1.30.m: Bearing the name of gold, and fond of gold; / you are Indra, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Fire;

1.30.s:
utphullaścitrabhānuśca svarbhānurbhānureva ca.
hotraṃ hotā ca homastvaṃ hutañca prahutaṃ prabhuḥ .. 30.242 ..
1.30.d:
उत्फुल्लश्चित्रभानुश्च स्वर्भानुर्भानुरेव च।
होत्रं होता च होमस्त्वं हुतञ्च प्रहुतं प्रभुः ॥ 30.242 ॥
1.30.m: The blooming, the sun, the eclipse-demon, and the sun itself; / you are the oblation, the priest, the sacrifice, the offered, the consecrated offering, the lord;

1.30.s:
suparṇañca tathā brahma yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam.
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāñca maṅgalam .. 30.243 ..
1.30.d:
सुपर्णञ्च तथा ब्रह्म यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्।
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानाञ्च मङ्गलम् ॥ 30.243 ॥
1.30.m: Garuḍa, Brahman, the Śatarudrīya of the Yajurveda, / the purifier of purifiers, and the auspicious among the auspicious.

1.30.s:
giriḥ stokastathā vṛkṣo jīvaḥ pudgala eva ca.
sattvaṃ tvañca rajastvañca tamaśca prajanaṃ tathā .. 30.244 ..
1.30.d:
गिरिः स्तोकस्तथा वृक्षो जीवः पुद्गल एव च।
सत्त्वं त्वञ्च रजस्त्वञ्च तमश्च प्रजनं तथा ॥ 30.244 ॥
1.30.m: The mountain, the drop, the tree, the soul, and matter; / you are sattva, you are rajas, you are tamas, and procreation.

1.30.s:
prāṇo'pānaḥ sāmānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca.
unmeṣaścaiva meṣaśca tathā jṛmbhitameva ca .. 30.245 ..
1.30.d:
प्राणोऽपानः सामानश्च उदानो व्यान एव च।
उन्मेषश्चैव मेषश्च तथा जृम्भितमेव च ॥ 30.245 ॥
1.30.m: Prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, and vyāna; / opening of the eyes, closing of the eyes, and yawning.

1.30.s:
lohitāṅgo gadī daṃṣṭrī mahāvaktro mahodaraḥ.
suciromā haricchmaśrurūrddhvakeśastrilocanaḥ .. 30.246 ..
1.30.d:
लोहिताङ्गो गदी दंष्ट्री महावक्त्रो महोदरः।
सुचिरोमा हरिच्छ्मश्रुरूर्द्ध्वकेशस्त्रिलोचनः ॥ 30.246 ॥
1.30.m: Red-limbed, bearing a club, tusked, large-mouthed, large-bellied, / with needle-like hair, yellow-bearded, with erect hair, three-eyed.

1.30.s:
gītavāditranṛtyāṅgo gītavādanakapriyaḥ.
matsyo jalī jalo jalya javaḥ kālaḥ kalī kalaḥ .. 30.247 ..
1.30.d:
गीतवादित्रनृत्याङ्गो गीतवादनकप्रियः।
मत्स्यो जली जलो जल्य जवः कालः कली कलः ॥ 30.247 ॥
1.30.m: Having singing, musical instruments, and dancing as limbs, fond of singing and instrumental music; / the fish, watery, water, born of water, speed, time, Kalī, the soft-sounding.

1.30.s:
vikālaśca sukālaśca duṣkālaḥ kalanāśanaḥ.
mṛtyuścaiva kṣayo'ntaśca kṣamāpāyakaro haraḥ .. 30.248 ..
1.30.d:
विकालश्च सुकालश्च दुष्कालः कलनाशनः।
मृत्युश्चैव क्षयोऽन्तश्च क्षमापायकरो हरः ॥ 30.248 ॥
1.30.m: The twilight, good time, bad time, the destroyer of calculating time; / death, decay, the end, the maker of dissolution and loss, Hara.

1.30.s:
saṃvarttako'ntakaścaiva saṃvarttakabalāhakau.
ghaṭo ghaṭīko ghaṇṭīko cūḍālolabalo balam .. 30.249 ..
1.30.d:
संवर्त्तकोऽन्तकश्चैव संवर्त्तकबलाहकौ।
घटो घटीको घण्टीको चूडालोलबलो बलम् ॥ 30.249 ॥
1.30.m: The all-destroying fire, the Ender, the cloud of cosmic destruction and the raincloud; / the jar, the water-clock, the bell-ringer, having trembling crest-locks, power, and strength.

1.30.s:
brahmakālo'gnivaktraśca daṇḍī muṇḍī ca daṇḍadhṛk.
caturyugaścaturvedaścaturhotraścatuṣpathaḥ .. 30.250 ..
1.30.d:
ब्रह्मकालोऽग्निवक्त्रश्च दण्डी मुण्डी च दण्डधृक्।
चतुर्युगश्चतुर्वेदश्चतुर्होत्रश्चतुष्पथः ॥ 30.250 ॥
1.30.m: Having the time of Brahmā, fire-mouthed, staff-bearing, shaven-headed, and holding a rod; / having the four yugas, the four Vedas, the four priests, the crossroads.

1.30.s:
caturā śramavettā ca cāturvarṇyakaraśca ha.
kṣarākṣarapriyo dhūrtto'gaṇyo'gaṇyagaṇādhipaḥ .. 30.251 ..
1.30.d:
चतुरा श्रमवेत्ता च चातुर्वर्ण्यकरश्च ह।
क्षराक्षरप्रियो धूर्त्तोऽगण्योऽगण्यगणाधिपः ॥ 30.251 ॥
1.30.m: Knowing the four life-stages, maker of the four classes; / fond of the perishable and imperishable, crafty, unreckonable, leader of the unreckonable hosts.

1.30.s:
rudrākṣamālyāmbaradharo giriko girikapriyaḥ.
śilpīśaḥ śilpināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvaśilpapravarttakaḥ .. 30.252 ..
1.30.d:
रुद्राक्षमाल्याम्बरधरो गिरिको गिरिकप्रियः।
शिल्पीशः शिल्पिनां श्रेष्ठः सर्वशिल्पप्रवर्त्तकः ॥ 30.252 ॥
1.30.m: Wearing a garland of rudrākṣa beads and garments, dwelling on mountains, lover of mountain maidens; / lord of artisans, best of artisans, originator of all crafts.

1.30.s:
bhaganetrāntakaścandraḥ pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ.
gūḍhāvarttaśca gūḍhaśca gūḍhapratiniṣevitā .. 30.253 ..
1.30.d:
भगनेत्रान्तकश्चन्द्रः पूष्णो दन्तविनाशनः।
गूढावर्त्तश्च गूढश्च गूढप्रतिनिषेविता ॥ 30.253 ॥
1.30.m: The destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, the moon, the destroyer of the teeth of Pūṣan; / the hidden whirlpool, hidden, frequented by those who are hidden.

1.30.s:
taraṇastā rakaścaiva sarvabhūtasutāraṇaḥ.
dhātā vidhātā satvānāṃ nidhātā dhāraṇo dharaḥ .. 30.254 ..
1.30.d:
तरणस्ता रकश्चैव सर्वभूतसुतारणः।
धाता विधाता सत्वानां निधाता धारणो धरः ॥ 30.254 ॥
1.30.m: The crosser, the ferryman, carrying all beings safely across; / the creator, the ordainer of beings, the layer down, the sustainer, the bearer.

1.30.s:
tapo brahma ca satyañca brahmacaryamathārjavam .
bhūtātmā bhūtakṛdbhūto bhūtabhavyabhavodbhavaḥ .. 30.255 ..
1.30.d:
तपो ब्रह्म च सत्यञ्च ब्रह्मचर्यमथार्जवम् ।
भूतात्मा भूतकृद्भूतो भूतभव्यभवोद्भवः ॥ 30.255 ॥
1.30.m: [You are] asceticism, the Veda, truth, celibacy, and uprightness; / the Self of beings, creator of beings, being, the source of what has been, what is, and what will be.

1.30.s:
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritaścaiva tathotpattirmaheśvaraḥ.
īśāno vīkṣaṇaḥ śānto durdānto dantanāśanaḥ .. 30.256 ..
1.30.d:
भूर्भुवःस्वरितश्चैव तथोत्पत्तिर्महेश्वरः।
ईशानो वीक्षणः शान्तो दुर्दान्तो दन्तनाशनः ॥ 30.256 ॥
1.30.m: [You are] earth, atmosphere, and heaven, and likewise their origin; Maheśvara, / Īśāna, contemplation, the peaceful, the hard to tame, the destroyer of teeth.

1.30.s:
brahmāvartta surāvartta kāmāvartta namo'stu te.
kāmabimbaniharttā ca karṇikārarajaḥpriyaḥ .. 30.257 ..
1.30.d:
ब्रह्मावर्त्त सुरावर्त्त कामावर्त्त नमोऽस्तु ते।
कामबिम्बनिहर्त्ता च कर्णिकाररजःप्रियः ॥ 30.257 ॥
1.30.m: O Brahmāvartta, O Surāvartta, O Kāmāvartta, praise be to you! / Destroyer of the form of Kāma, fond of karṇikāra pollen,

1.30.s:
mukhacandro bhīmamukhaḥ sumukho durmukho mukhaḥ.
caturmukho bahumukho raṇe hyabhimukhaḥ sadā .. 30.258 ..
1.30.d:
मुखचन्द्रो भीममुखः सुमुखो दुर्मुखो मुखः।
चतुर्मुखो बहुमुखो रणे ह्यभिमुखः सदा ॥ 30.258 ॥
1.30.m: moon-faced, terrible-faced, handsome-faced, ugly-faced, the face, / four-faced, many-faced, indeed always turned facing [the enemy] in battle,

1.30.s:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śakunirmahodadhiḥ paro virāṭ .
adharmahā mahādaṇḍo daṇḍadhāro raṇapriyaḥ .. 30.259 ..
1.30.d:
हिरण्यगर्भः शकुनिर्महोदधिः परो विराट् ।
अधर्महा महादण्डो दण्डधारो रणप्रियः ॥ 30.259 ॥
1.30.m: Hiraṇyagarbha, the bird, the great ocean, the supreme sovereign, / slayer of unrighteousness, holder of the great rod of punishment, staff-bearer, fond of battle,

1.30.s:
gotamogopratāraśca govṛṣeścaravāhanaḥ.
dharmakṛddharmasraṣṭā ca dharmo dharmaviduttamaḥ .. 30.260 ..
1.30.d:
गोतमोगोप्रतारश्च गोवृषेश्चरवाहनः।
धर्मकृद्धर्मस्रष्टा च धर्मो धर्मविदुत्तमः ॥ 30.260 ॥
1.30.m: Gotama, ferrier across the cow, having the bull for his mount, / maker of dharma, creator of dharma, dharma, best of knowers of dharma,

1.30.s:
trailokyagoptā govindo mānado māna eva ca.
tiṣṭhan sthiraśca sthāṇuśca niṣkampaḥ kampa eva ca .. 30.261 ..
1.30.d:
त्रैलोक्यगोप्ता गोविन्दो मानदो मान एव च।
तिष्ठन् स्थिरश्च स्थाणुश्च निष्कम्पः कम्प एव च ॥ 30.261 ॥
1.30.m: protector of the three worlds, Govinda, granter of honor, and honor itself, / standing, firm, stationary, motionless, and trembling itself,

1.30.s:
durvāraṇo durviṣado duḥsaho duratikramaḥ.
durddharo duṣprakampaśca durvido durjjayo jayaḥ .. 30.262 ..
1.30.d:
दुर्वारणो दुर्विषदो दुःसहो दुरतिक्रमः।
दुर्द्धरो दुष्प्रकम्पश्च दुर्विदो दुर्ज्जयो जयः ॥ 30.262 ॥
1.30.m: irresistible, hard to enter, difficult to endure, hard to surpass, / hard to bear, difficult to shake, hard to know, difficult to conquer, victory,

1.30.s:
śaśaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ śamanaḥ śītoṣṇaṃ durjarā'tha tṛṭ.
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva vyādhihā vyādhigaśca ha .. 30.263 ..
1.30.d:
शशः शशाङ्कः शमनः शीतोष्णं दुर्जराऽथ तृट्।
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव व्याधिहा व्याधिगश्च ह ॥ 30.263 ॥
1.30.m: the hare, the hare-marked [moon], the pacifier, cold and heat, severe old age, thirst, / mental sorrows, and bodily illnesses, destroyer of illness, and hunter.

1.30.s:
sahyo yajño mṛgā vyādhā vyādhīnāmākaro'karaḥ .
śikhaṇḍī puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ puṇḍarīkāvalokanaḥ .. 30.264 ..
1.30.d:
सह्यो यज्ञो मृगा व्याधा व्याधीनामाकरोऽकरः ।
शिखण्डी पुण्डरीकाक्षः पुण्डरीकावलोकनः ॥ 30.264 ॥
1.30.m: Sahya, sacrifice, deer, hunters, the source of diseases, non-acting, / crest-wearing, lotus-eyed, lotus-gazing,

1.30.s:
daṇḍadharaḥ sadaṇḍaśca daṇḍamuṇḍavibhūṣitaḥ.
viṣapo'mṛtapaścaiva surāpaḥ kṣīrasomapaḥ .. 30.265 ..
1.30.d:
दण्डधरः सदण्डश्च दण्डमुण्डविभूषितः।
विषपोऽमृतपश्चैव सुरापः क्षीरसोमपः ॥ 30.265 ॥
1.30.m: staff-bearer, carrying a staff, adorned with a staff and skulls, / drinker of poison, drinker of nectar, drinker of surā, drinker of milk and soma,

1.30.s:
madhupaścājyapaścaiva sarvapaśca mahābalaḥ.
vṛṣāśvavāhyo vṛṣabhastathā vṛṣabhalocanaḥ .. 30.266 ..
1.30.d:
मधुपश्चाज्यपश्चैव सर्वपश्च महाबलः।
वृषाश्ववाह्यो वृषभस्तथा वृषभलोचनः ॥ 30.266 ॥
1.30.m: drinker of honey, drinker of clarified butter, all-drinker, of great strength, / borne by a bull and horse, the bull, and bull-eyed,

1.30.s:
vṛṣabhaścaiva vikhyāto lokānāṃ lokasatkṛtaḥ.
candrādityau cakṣuṣī te hṛdayañca pitāmahaḥ.
agnirāpastathā devo dharmakarmaprasādhitaḥ .. 30.267 ..
1.30.d:
वृषभश्चैव विख्यातो लोकानां लोकसत्कृतः।
चन्द्रादित्यौ चक्षुषी ते हृदयञ्च पितामहः।
अग्निरापस्तथा देवो धर्मकर्मप्रसाधितः ॥ 30.267 ॥
1.30.m: renowned as the bull of the worlds, honored by the worlds; / the moon and sun are your eyes, and the Grandfather is your heart; / Agni and water are the god adorned by righteous actions.

1.30.s:
na brahmā na ca govindaḥ purāṇaṛṣayo na ca.
māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yāthātathyena te śiva .. 30.268 ..
1.30.d:
न ब्रह्मा न च गोविन्दः पुराणऋषयो न च।
माहात्म्यं वेदितुं शक्ता याथातथ्येन ते शिव ॥ 30.268 ॥
1.30.m: Neither Brahmā nor Govinda, nor the ancient seers, / are able to know your majesty as it truly is, O Śiva.

1.30.s:
yā mūrttayaḥ susūkṣmāste na mahyaṃ yānti darśanam.
tābhirṇāṃ satataṃ rakṣa pitā putramivaurasam .. 30.269 ..
1.30.d:
या मूर्त्तयः सुसूक्ष्मास्ते न मह्यं यान्ति दर्शनम्।
ताभिर्णां सततं रक्ष पिता पुत्रमिवौरसम् ॥ 30.269 ॥
1.30.m: Those very subtle forms of yours do not come within my sight; / with them protect me constantly, like a father his own son.

1.30.s: rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'haṃ tavānagha namo'stu te ..
1.30.d: रक्ष मां रक्षणीयोऽहं तवानघ नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
1.30.m: Protect me; I am to be protected by you, O sinless one; salutations to you! / The Lord is compassionate to his devotees, and I am ever devoted to you.

1.30.s: bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhaktaścāhaṃ sadā tvayi .. 30.270 ..
1.30.d: भक्तानुकम्पी भगवान् भक्तश्चाहं सदा त्वयि ॥ 30.270 ॥

1.30.s:
yaḥ sahasrāṇyanekāni puṃsāmāhṛtya durddaśaḥ.
tiṣṭhatyekaḥ samudrānte sa me goptāstu nityaśaḥ .. 30.271 ..
1.30.d:
यः सहस्राण्यनेकानि पुंसामाहृत्य दुर्द्दशः।
तिष्ठत्येकः समुद्रान्ते स मे गोप्तास्तु नित्यशः ॥ 30.271 ॥
1.30.m: He who, having gathered many thousands of men, difficult to behold, / stands alone at the edge of the ocean, may he be my constant protector.

1.30.s:
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ.
jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ .. 30.272 ..
1.30.d:
यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शिनः।
ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास्तस्मै योगात्मने नमः ॥ 30.272 ॥
1.30.m: Whom the sleepless, whose breath is conquered, dwelling in sattva, seeing equally, / yogins behold as light—to that Self of yoga, praise!

1.30.s:
sambhakṣya sarva bhūtāni yugānte samupasthite.
yaḥ śete jalamadhyasthastaṃ prapadye'psuśāyinam .. 30.273 ..
1.30.d:
सम्भक्ष्य सर्व भूतानि युगान्ते समुपस्थिते।
यः शेते जलमध्यस्थस्तं प्रपद्येऽप्सुशायिनम् ॥ 30.273 ॥
1.30.m: Having devoured all beings when the end of the yuga has arrived, / who lies amidst the waters—to that one reclining on the waters I go for refuge.

1.30.s:
praviśya vadane rāhoryaḥ somaṃ grasate niśi .
grasatyarkañca svarbhānurbhutvā somāgnireva ca .. 30.274 ..
1.30.d:
प्रविश्य वदने राहोर्यः सोमं ग्रसते निशि ।
ग्रसत्यर्कञ्च स्वर्भानुर्भुत्वा सोमाग्निरेव च ॥ 30.274 ॥
1.30.m: Entering Rāhu's mouth, he swallows the moon by night; / and becoming Svarbhānu, he swallows the sun, being soma and fire.

1.30.s:
ye'ṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣā dehasthāḥ sarvadehinām.
rakṣantu te hi māṃ nityaṃ nityamāpyāyayantu mām .. 30.275 ..
1.30.d:
येऽङ्गुष्ठमात्राः पुरुषा देहस्थाः सर्वदेहिनाम्।
रक्षन्तु ते हि मां नित्यं नित्यमाप्याययन्तु माम् ॥ 30.275 ॥
1.30.m: Those persons the size of a thumb, who reside in the bodies of all embodied beings, / may they indeed protect me always, may they constantly refresh me.

1.30.s:
ye cāpyutpatitā garbhādadhobhāgagatāśca ye.
teṣāṃ svāhāḥ svadhāścaiva āpnuvantu svadantu ca .. 30.276 ..
1.30.d:
ये चाप्युत्पतिता गर्भादधोभागगताश्च ये।
तेषां स्वाहाः स्वधाश्चैव आप्नुवन्तु स्वदन्तु च ॥ 30.276 ॥
1.30.m: And those who have emerged from the womb, and those who have gone to the lower regions, / may their svāhās and svadhās reach them and be enjoyed.

1.30.s:
ye na rodanti dehasthāḥ prāṇino rodayanti ca.
harṣayanti ca hṛṣyanti namastebhyo'stu nityaśaḥ .. 30.277 ..
1.30.d:
ये न रोदन्ति देहस्थाः प्राणिनो रोदयन्ति च।
हर्षयन्ति च हृष्यन्ति नमस्तेभ्योऽस्तु नित्यशः ॥ 30.277 ॥
1.30.m: Those residing in the body who do not weep, but make living creatures weep, / and cause joy and rejoice—to them be praise constantly!

1.30.s:
ye samudre nadīdurge parvateṣu guhāsu ca.
vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu na .. 30.278 ..
1.30.d:
ये समुद्रे नदीदुर्गे पर्वतेषु गुहासु च।
वृक्षमूलेषु गोष्ठेषु कान्तारगहनेषु न ॥ 30.278 ॥
1.30.m: Those who are in the ocean, in inaccessible rivers, in mountains, and in caves, / at the bases of trees, in cattle-pens, in deep forests, and in

1.30.s:
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca.
candrārkayormadhyagatā ye ca candrārkaraśmiṣu .. 30.279 ..
1.30.d:
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चत्वरेषु सभासु च।
चन्द्रार्कयोर्मध्यगता ये च चन्द्रार्करश्मिषु ॥ 30.279 ॥
1.30.m: crossroads, highways, courtyards, and assemblies, / those situated between the moon and the sun, and those in the rays of the moon and sun,

1.30.s:
rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmātparaṅgatāḥ.
namastebhyo namastebhyo namastebhyaśca nityaśaḥ.
sūkṣmāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā hrasvā namastebhyastu nityaśaḥ .. 30.280 ..
1.30.d:
रसातलगता ये च ये च तस्मात्परङ्गताः।
नमस्तेभ्यो नमस्तेभ्यो नमस्तेभ्यश्च नित्यशः।
सूक्ष्माः स्थूलाः कृशा ह्रस्वा नमस्तेभ्यस्तु नित्यशः ॥ 30.280 ॥
1.30.m: and those who have gone to the netherworld, and those who have gone beyond it— / praise to them, praise to them, and praise to them constantly! / Subtle, gross, lean, and short—to them be praise constantly!

1.30.s:
sarvastvaṃ sarvago deva sarvabhūtapatirbhavān.
sarvabhūtāntarātmā ca tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ .. 30.281 ..
1.30.d:
सर्वस्त्वं सर्वगो देव सर्वभूतपतिर्भवान्।
सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा च तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः ॥ 30.281 ॥
1.30.m: You are all, all-pervading, O God; you are the lord of all beings, / and the inner self of all beings; therefore, you were not invited.

1.30.s:
tvameva cejyase yasmādyajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ.
tvameva karttā sarvasya tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ .. 30.282 ..
1.30.d:
त्वमेव चेज्यसे यस्माद्यज्ञैर्विविधदक्षिणैः।
त्वमेव कर्त्ता सर्वस्य तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः ॥ 30.282 ॥
1.30.m: Because you alone are worshipped through sacrifices with various priestly gifts, / you alone are the doer of everything; therefore, you were not invited.

1.30.s:
atha vā māyayā deva mohitaḥ sūkṣmayā tvayā.
etasmāt kāraṇādvāpi tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ .. 30.283 ..
1.30.d:
अथ वा मायया देव मोहितः सूक्ष्मया त्वया।
एतस्मात् कारणाद्वापि तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः ॥ 30.283 ॥
1.30.m: Or rather, O God, I was deluded by your subtle māyā; / or for this reason, therefore, you were not invited.

1.30.s:
prasīda mama deveśa tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama.
tvaṃ gatistvaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca na cānyāsti na me gatiḥ .. 30.284 ..
1.30.d:
प्रसीद मम देवेश त्वमेव शरणं मम।
त्वं गतिस्त्वं प्रतिष्ठा च न चान्यास्ति न मे गतिः ॥ 30.284 ॥
1.30.m: Be gracious to me, O Lord of gods! You alone are my refuge. / You are the destination, you are the foundation, and there is no other refuge for me.

1.30.s:
stutvaivaṃ sa mahādevaṃ virarāma prajāpātiḥ.
bhagavānapi suprītaḥ punardakṣamabhāṣata .. 30.285 ..
1.30.d:
स्तुत्वैवं स महादेवं विरराम प्रजापातिः।
भगवानपि सुप्रीतः पुनर्दक्षमभाषत ॥ 30.285 ॥
1.30.m: Having thus praised Mahādeva, Prajāpati [Dakṣa] paused. / The Lord, highly pleased, spoke again to Dakṣa:

1.30.s:
parituṣṭo'smi te dakṣa stavenānena suvrata.
bahunātra kimuktena matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyasi .. 30.286 ..
1.30.d:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते दक्ष स्तवेनानेन सुव्रत।
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मत्समीपं गमिष्यसि ॥ 30.286 ॥
1.30.m: "I am well pleased with you, O Dakṣa of good vows, by this hymn of praise. / What is the use of speaking much here? You will come to my presence.

1.30.s:
athainamabravīdvākyaṃ trailokyādhipatirbhavaḥ.
kṛtvāśvāsakaraṃ vākyaṃ vākyajño vākyamāhatam .. 30.287 ..
1.30.d:
अथैनमब्रवीद्वाक्यं त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्भवः।
कृत्वाश्वासकरं वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यमाहतम् ॥ 30.287 ॥
1.30.m: Then Bhava, the master of the three worlds, skilled in speech, / spoke comforting words to him, words deeply felt:

1.30.s:
dakṣa dakṣa na karttavyo manyurvighnamimaṃ prati.
ahaṃ yajñahā na tvanyo dṛśyate tatpurā tvayā .. 30.288 ..
1.30.d:
दक्ष दक्ष न कर्त्तव्यो मन्युर्विघ्नमिमं प्रति।
अहं यज्ञहा न त्वन्यो दृश्यते तत्पुरा त्वया ॥ 30.288 ॥
1.30.m: "Dakṣa, Dakṣa! Anger must not be felt regarding this impediment. / I am the destroyer of the sacrifice; no other is seen [to do it], as was seen by you before.

1.30.s:
bhūyaśca taṃ varamimaṃ matto gṛhṇīṣva suvrata.
prasannavadano bhūtvā tvamekāgramanāḥ śrṛṇu .. 30.289 ..
1.30.d:
भूयश्च तं वरमिमं मत्तो गृह्णीष्व सुव्रत।
प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा त्वमेकाग्रमनाः श्रृणु ॥ 30.289 ॥
1.30.m: Further, receive this boon from me, O you of good vows: / with a serene countenance and focused mind, listen:

1.30.s:
aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca.
prajāpate matprasādāt phalabhāgī bhaviṣyasi .. 30.290 ..
1.30.d:
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च।
प्रजापते मत्प्रसादात् फलभागी भविष्यसि ॥ 30.290 ॥
1.30.m: Of a thousand horse-sacrifices and a hundred Vājapeyas, / O Prajāpati, by my grace you will share in the fruit.

1.30.s:
vedān ṣaḍaṅgānuddhṛtya sāṅkhyānyogāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ.
tapaśca vipulaṃ taptvā duścaraṃ devadānavaiḥ .. 30.291 ..
1.30.d:
वेदान् षडङ्गानुद्धृत्य साङ्ख्यान्योगांश्च कृत्स्नशः।
तपश्च विपुलं तप्त्वा दुश्चरं देवदानवैः ॥ 30.291 ॥
1.30.m: Having extracted the essence of the Vedas with their six limbs, and the Sāṅkhya and Yoga completely, / and having performed great asceticism difficult to perform even by gods and dānavas,

1.30.s:
arthairddaśārddhasaṃyuktairgūḍhamaprājñanirmmitam.
varṇāśramakṛtairdharmaiṃrviparītaṃ kvacitsamam .. 30.292 ..
1.30.d:
अर्थैर्द्दशार्द्धसंयुक्तैर्गूढमप्राज्ञनिर्म्मितम्।
वर्णाश्रमकृतैर्धर्मैंर्विपरीतं क्वचित्समम् ॥ 30.292 ॥
1.30.m: composed of fivefold topics, hidden, uncreated by the foolish, / contrary in some respects to the duties prescribed for castes and stages of life, and in some respects equal,

1.30.s:
śrutyarthairadhyavasitaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam.
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāntu mayā pāśupataṃ vratam.
utpāditaṃ śubhaṃ dakṣa sarvapāpavimokṣaṇam .. 30.293 ..
1.30.d:
श्रुत्यर्थैरध्यवसितं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्।
सर्वेषामाश्रमाणान्तु मया पाशुपतं व्रतम्।
उत्पादितं शुभं दक्ष सर्वपापविमोक्षणम् ॥ 30.293 ॥
1.30.m: determined by the meanings of the Śruti, freeing from the fetters of individual souls, / for all stages of life, the auspicious Pāśupata observance has been originated by me, / O Dakṣa, which frees one from all sins.

1.30.s:
asya cīrṇasya yatsamyak phalaṃ bhavati puṣkalam.
tadastu te mahābhāga mānasastyajyatāṃ jvaraḥ .. 30.294 ..
1.30.d:
अस्य चीर्णस्य यत्सम्यक् फलं भवति पुष्कलम्।
तदस्तु ते महाभाग मानसस्त्यज्यतां ज्वरः ॥ 30.294 ॥
1.30.m: Whatever abundant fruit comes from this when properly observed, / let that belong to you, O fortunate one; let mental distress be cast away."

1.30.s:
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ.
adarśanamanuprāpto dakṣasyāmitavikramaḥ .. 30.295 ..
1.30.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः सपत्नीकः सहानुगः।
अदर्शनमनुप्राप्तो दक्षस्यामितविक्रमः ॥ 30.295 ॥
1.30.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva of immeasurable valor, / accompanied by his wife and attendants, vanished from Dakṣa's sight.

1.30.s:
avāpya ca tadā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā bhavaḥ.
jvarañca sarvadharmajño bahudhā vyabhajattadā.
śāntyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrṛṇudhvaṃ tatra vai dvijāḥ .. 30.296 ..
1.30.d:
अवाप्य च तदा भागं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मणा भवः।
ज्वरञ्च सर्वधर्मज्ञो बहुधा व्यभजत्तदा।
शान्त्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां श्रृणुध्वं तत्र वै द्विजाः ॥ 30.296 ॥
1.30.m:
And then, having received his share as declared by Brahmā, Bhava,
who knows all dharma, divided fever into many parts
for the appeasement of all beings. Listen to that, O twice-born.

1.30.s:
śīrṣābhitāpo nāgānāṃ parvatānāṃ śilārujaḥ.
apāntu nālikāṃ vidyānnirmokambhujageṣvapi .. 30.297 ..
1.30.d:
शीर्षाभितापो नागानां पर्वतानां शिलारुजः।
अपान्तु नालिकां विद्यान्निर्मोकम्भुजगेष्वपि ॥ 30.297 ॥
1.30.m:
Head-heat in elephants, splitting of rocks in mountains,
reed-rot in waters, and shedding of skin among serpents,

1.30.s:
śaurakaḥ saurabheyāṇāmūṣaraḥ pṛthivītale .
ibhā nāmapi dharmajña dṛṣṭipratyavarodhanam .. 30.298 ..
1.30.d:
शौरकः सौरभेयाणामूषरः पृथिवीतले ।
इभा नामपि धर्मज्ञ दृष्टिप्रत्यवरोधनम् ॥ 30.298 ॥
1.30.m:
foot-and-mouth disease in cattle, barrenness in the surface of the earth,
and in elephants, O knower of dharma, obstruction of sight,

1.30.s:
randhrodbhūtaṃ tathāśvānāṃ śikhodbhedaśca barhiṇām.
netrarogaḥ kokilānāṃ jvaraḥ prokto mahātmabhiḥ .. 30.299 ..
1.30.d:
रन्ध्रोद्भूतं तथाश्वानां शिखोद्भेदश्च बर्हिणाम्।
नेत्ररोगः कोकिलानां ज्वरः प्रोक्तो महात्मभिः ॥ 30.299 ॥
1.30.m:
choking in the throat in horses, and splitting of the crest in peacocks,
eye-disease in cuckoos—this fever has been proclaimed by the great-souled;

1.30.s:
ajānāṃ pittabhedaśca sarveṣāmiti naḥ śrutam.
śukānāmapi sarveṣāṃ himikā procyate jvaraḥ.
śārdūleṣvapi vai viprāḥ śramo jvara ihocyate .. 30.300 ..
1.30.d:
अजानां पित्तभेदश्च सर्वेषामिति नः श्रुतम्।
शुकानामपि सर्वेषां हिमिका प्रोच्यते ज्वरः।
शार्दूलेष्वपि वै विप्राः श्रमो ज्वर इहोच्यते ॥ 30.300 ॥

1.30.s:
mānuṣeṣu tu sarvajña jvaro nāmaiṣa kīrtitaḥ.
maraṇe janmani tathā madhye ca viśate sadā .. 30.301 ..
1.30.d:
मानुषेषु तु सर्वज्ञ ज्वरो नामैष कीर्तितः।
मरणे जन्मनि तथा मध्ये च विशते सदा ॥ 30.301 ॥
1.30.m:
Among human beings, O all-knowing one, it is known by the name 'fever';
at death, at birth, and likewise in between, it enters constantly.

1.30.s:
etanmāheśvaraṃ tejau jvaro nāma sudāruṇaḥ.
namasyaścaiva mānyaśca sarvaprāṇibhirīśvaraḥ .. 30.302 ..
1.30.d:
एतन्माहेश्वरं तेजौ ज्वरो नाम सुदारुणः।
नमस्यश्चैव मान्यश्च सर्वप्राणिभिरीश्वरः ॥ 30.302 ॥
1.30.m:
This is the fire of the Great Lord, the very fierce [power] named fever.
The Lord is to be saluted and revered by all living beings.

1.30.s:
imāṃ jvarotpattimadīnamānasaḥ paṭhetsadā yaḥ susamāhito naraḥ .
vimuktarogaḥ sa naro mudā yuto labheta kāmān sa yathāmanīṣitān .. 30.303 ..
1.30.d:
इमां ज्वरोत्पत्तिमदीनमानसः पठेत्सदा यः सुसमाहितो नरः ।
विमुक्तरोगः स नरो मुदा युतो लभेत कामान् स यथामनीषितान् ॥ 30.303 ॥
1.30.m:
That man who, with cheerful mind and well concentrated, always recites this origin of fever,
freed from disease and filled with joy, attains his desires as wished.

1.30.s:
dakṣaproktaṃ stavañcāpi kīrttayedyaḥ śrṛṇoti vā.
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiñciddīrghañcāyuravāpnuyāt .. 30.304 ..
1.30.d:
दक्षप्रोक्तं स्तवञ्चापि कीर्त्तयेद्यः श्रृणोति वा।
नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात् किञ्चिद्दीर्घञ्चायुरवाप्नुयात् ॥ 30.304 ॥
1.30.m:
And whoever proclaims or listens to the hymn spoken by Dakṣa
will suffer nothing inauspicious and will attain a long life.

1.30.s:
yathā sarveṣu deveṣu variṣṭho yogavān haraḥ.
tathā stavo variṣṭho'yaṃ stavānāṃ brahmanirmitaḥ .. 30.305 ..
1.30.d:
यथा सर्वेषु देवेषु वरिष्ठो योगवान् हरः।
तथा स्तवो वरिष्ठोऽयं स्तवानां ब्रह्मनिर्मितः ॥ 30.305 ॥
1.30.m:
Just as Hara, possessed of yoga, is foremost among all gods,
so this hymn, composed by Brahmā, is foremost among hymns.

1.30.s:
yaśorājyasukhaiśvaryavittāyurdhanakāṅkṣibhiḥ.
stotavyo bhaktimāsthāya vidyākāmaiśca yatnataḥ .. 30.306 ..
1.30.d:
यशोराज्यसुखैश्वर्यवित्तायुर्धनकाङ्क्षिभिः।
स्तोतव्यो भक्तिमास्थाय विद्याकामैश्च यत्नतः ॥ 30.306 ॥
1.30.m:
By those desiring fame, sovereignty, happiness, sovereign power, wealth, long life, and riches,
and by those desiring learning, it should be recited with devotion and effort.

1.30.s:
vyādhito duḥkhito dīnaścauratrasto bhayārditaḥ.
rājakāryaniyukto vā mucyate mahato bhayāt .. 30.307 ..
1.30.d:
व्याधितो दुःखितो दीनश्चौरत्रस्तो भयार्दितः।
राजकार्यनियुक्तो वा मुच्यते महतो भयात् ॥ 30.307 ॥
1.30.m:
A person who is diseased, afflicted, wretched, terrified of thieves, tormented by fear,
or charged with the king's duties, is released from great fear.

1.30.s:
anena caiva dehena gaṇānāṃ sa gaṇādhipaḥ.
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya gaṇa evopapadyate .. 30.308 ..
1.30.d:
अनेन चैव देहेन गणानां स गणाधिपः।
इह लोके सुखं प्राप्य गण एवोपपद्यते ॥ 30.308 ॥
1.30.m:
Even with this body he becomes a lord of the hosts of [Śiva's] attendants;
having attained happiness in this world, he is born as an attendant [of Śiva].

1.30.s:
na ca yakṣāḥ piśācā vā na nāgā na vināyakāḥ.
kuryurvighnaṃ gṛhe tasya yatra saṃstūyate bhavaḥ .. 30.309 ..
1.30.d:
न च यक्षाः पिशाचा वा न नागा न विनायकाः।
कुर्युर्विघ्नं गृहे तस्य यत्र संस्तूयते भवः ॥ 30.309 ॥
1.30.m:
Neither yakṣas, nor piśācas, nor nāgas, nor vināyakas
will cause obstruction in his house where Bhava is praised.

1.30.s:
śrṛṇuyādvā idaṃ nārī subhaktyā brahmacāriṇī.
pitṛbhirbhartṛpakṣābhyāṃ pūjyā bhavati devavat .. 30.310 ..
1.30.d:
श्रृणुयाद्वा इदं नारी सुभक्त्या ब्रह्मचारिणी।
पितृभिर्भर्तृपक्षाभ्यां पूज्या भवति देववत् ॥ 30.310 ॥
1.30.m:
Or if a chaste woman should listen to this with true devotion,
she becomes worthy of worship like a deity by both her ancestors and her husband’s family.

1.30.s:
śrṛṇuyādvā idaṃ sarva kīrttayedvāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ.
tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ gacchantyavighnataḥ .. 30.311 ..
1.30.d:
श्रृणुयाद्वा इदं सर्व कीर्त्तयेद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः।
तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धिं गच्छन्त्यविघ्नतः ॥ 30.311 ॥
1.30.m:
If one should hear all this or recite it repeatedly,
all his undertakings go to success without obstruction.

1.30.s:
manasā cintitaṃ yacca yacca vācāpyudāhṛtam.
sarvaṃ sampadyate tasya stavanasyānukīrttanāt .. 30.312 ..
1.30.d:
मनसा चिन्तितं यच्च यच्च वाचाप्युदाहृतम्।
सर्वं सम्पद्यते तस्य स्तवनस्यानुकीर्त्तनात् ॥ 30.312 ॥
1.30.m:
Whatever is thought by the mind and whatever is uttered in speech—
all that is accomplished for him from the proclamation of this hymn.

1.30.s:
devasya saguhasyātha devyā nandīśvarasya tu.
baliṃ vibhavataḥ kṛtvā damena niyamena ca .. 30.313 ..
1.30.d:
देवस्य सगुहस्याथ देव्या नन्दीश्वरस्य तु।
बलिं विभवतः कृत्वा दमेन नियमेन च ॥ 30.313 ॥
1.30.m:
Having offered oblations according to one's wealth to the God with Guha,
and to the Goddess and to Nandīśvara, with self-control and restraint,

1.30.s:
tataḥ sa yukto gṛhṇīyānnāmānyāśu yathākramam.
īpsitān labhate'tyarthaṃ kāmān bhogāṃśca mānavaḥ.
mṛtaśca svargamāpnoti strīsahasraparivṛtaḥ .. 30.314 ..
1.30.d:
ततः स युक्तो गृह्णीयान्नामान्याशु यथाक्रमम्।
ईप्सितान् लभतेऽत्यर्थं कामान् भोगांश्च मानवः।
मृतश्च स्वर्गमाप्नोति स्त्रीसहस्रपरिवृतः ॥ 30.314 ॥

1.30.s:
sarva karmasu yukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ.
paṭhan dakṣakṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate.
mṛtaśca gaṇasālokyaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 30.315 ..
1.30.d:
सर्व कर्मसु युक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः।
पठन् दक्षकृतं स्तोत्रं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।
मृतश्च गणसालोक्यं पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः ॥ 30.315 ॥

1.30.s:
vṛṣeva vidhiyuktena vimānena virājate.
ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī rudrasyānucaro bhavet .. 30.316 ..
1.30.d:
वृषेव विधियुक्तेन विमानेन विराजते।
आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् ॥ 30.316 ॥
1.30.m:
Like a bull, he shines in an aerial chariot properly equipped;
remaining until the dissolution of all beings, he becomes a follower of Rudra.

1.30.s:
ityāha bhagavān vyāsaḥ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ .
naitadvedayate kaścinnedaṃ śrāvyantu kasyacit .. 30.317 ..
1.30.d:
इत्याह भगवान् व्यासः पराशरसुतः प्रभुः ।
नैतद्वेदयते कश्चिन्नेदं श्राव्यन्तु कस्यचित् ॥ 30.317 ॥
1.30.m:
Thus spoke the lord, the venerable Vyāsa, son of Parāśara:
No one reveals this; nor should this be recited to just anyone.

1.30.s:
śrutvaitatparamaṃ guhyaṃ ye'pi syuḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ.
vaiśyāḥ striyaśca śūdrāśca rudralokamavāpnuyuḥ .. 30.318 ..
1.30.d:
श्रुत्वैतत्परमं गुह्यं येऽपि स्युः पापकारिणः।
वैश्याः स्त्रियश्च शूद्राश्च रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयुः ॥ 30.318 ॥
1.30.m:
Having heard this supreme secret, even if they are evildoers,
vaiśyas, women, and śūdras would attain the realm of Rudra.

1.30.s:
śrāvayedyastu viprebhyaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu.
rudralokamavāpnoti dvijo vai nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 30.319 ..
1.30.d:
श्रावयेद्यस्तु विप्रेभ्यः सदा पर्वसु पर्वसु।
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति द्विजो वै नात्र संशयः ॥ 30.319 ॥
1.30.m:
And whichever twice-born recites it to Brahmins always on every festival day
attains the realm of Rudra; there is no doubt about this.

1.30.s: iti śrīmahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte dakṣaśāpavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 30 ..
1.30.d: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते दक्षशापवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ 30 ॥
1.30.m: Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Curse of Dakṣa', in the glorious Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

1.31.s: ..sūta uvāca ..
1.31.d: ॥सूत उवाच ॥
1.31.m:
The Sūta said:
Thus has this sin-destroying story been related, / which, concerning Dakṣa here, originated from Śarva.

1.31.s:
ityeṣā samanujñātā kathā pāpapraṇāśinī.
yā dakṣamadhikṛtyeha kathā śarvādupāgatā .. 31.1 ..
1.31.d:
इत्येषा समनुज्ञाता कथा पापप्रणाशिनी।
या दक्षमधिकृत्येह कथा शर्वादुपागता ॥ 31.1 ॥

1.31.s:
pitṛvaṃśaprasaṅgena kathā hyeṣā prakīrtitā.
pitṝṇāmānupūrvyeṇa devān vakṣyāmyataḥ param .. 31.2 ..
1.31.d:
पितृवंशप्रसङ्गेन कथा ह्येषा प्रकीर्तिता।
पितॄणामानुपूर्व्येण देवान् वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ॥ 31.2 ॥
1.31.m:
For this story was related in connection with the lineage of the ancestors.
Hereafter, in proper order after the ancestors, I will speak of the gods.

1.31.s:
tretāyugamukhe pūrvamāsan svāyambhuve'ntare .
devā yāmā iti khyātāḥ pūrvaṃ ye yajñasūnavaḥ .. 31.3 ..
1.31.d:
त्रेतायुगमुखे पूर्वमासन् स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे ।
देवा यामा इति ख्याताः पूर्वं ये यज्ञसूनवः ॥ 31.3 ॥
1.31.m:
Formerly, at the beginning of the Tretāyuga, in the cosmic age of Svāyambhuva,
there were gods known as the Yāmas, who had earlier been the sons of Yajña.

1.31.s:
ajitā brahmaṇaḥ putrā jitā jidajitāśca ye.
putrāḥ svāyambhuvasyaite śukranāmnā mānasāḥ .. 31.4 ..
1.31.d:
अजिता ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा जिता जिदजिताश्च ये।
पुत्राः स्वायम्भुवस्यैते शुक्रनाम्ना मानसाः ॥ 31.4 ॥
1.31.m:
The Ajitas were the sons of Brahmā, and those who were the Jitas and Jidajitas—
these were the mind-born sons of Svāyambhuva named Śukra.

1.31.s:
tṛptimanto gaṇā hyete devānāntu trayaḥ smṛtāḥ .
chandogāstu trayastriṃśatsarve svāyambhuvasya ha .. 31.5 ..
1.31.d:
तृप्तिमन्तो गणा ह्येते देवानान्तु त्रयः स्मृताः ।
छन्दोगास्तु त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सर्वे स्वायम्भुवस्य ह ॥ 31.5 ॥
1.31.m:
These three satisfied groups of gods are recorded;
and the Chandogas, thirty-three in all, belonged to Svāyambhuva.

1.31.s:
yaduryayātirdvau devau dīdhayaḥ sravaso matiḥ.
vibhāsaśca kratuścaiva prajātirviśato dyutiḥ .. 31.6 ..
1.31.d:
यदुर्ययातिर्द्वौ देवौ दीधयः स्रवसो मतिः।
विभासश्च क्रतुश्चैव प्रजातिर्विशतो द्युतिः ॥ 31.6 ॥
1.31.m:
Yadu and Yayāti were two gods, Dīdhaya, Sravasa, Mati,
Vibhāsa, Kratu, Prajāti, Viśata, Dyuti,

1.31.s:
vāyaso maṅgalaścaiva yāmā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ.
abhimanyurugradṛṣṭiḥ samayo'tha śuciśravāḥ.
kevalo viśvarūpaśca supakṣo madhupastathā .. 31.7 ..
1.31.d:
वायसो मङ्गलश्चैव यामा द्वादश कीर्तिताः।
अभिमन्युरुग्रदृष्टिः समयोऽथ शुचिश्रवाः।
केवलो विश्वरूपश्च सुपक्षो मधुपस्तथा ॥ 31.7 ॥
1.31.m:
Vāyasa, and Maṅgala—these twelve are proclaimed as the Yāmas.
Abhimanyu, Ugradṛṣṭi, Samaya, then Śuciśravas,
Kevala, Viśvarūpa, Supakṣa, likewise Madhupa,

1.31.s:
turīyo nirhapuścaiva yukto grāvājinastu te.
yamino viśvadevādyaṃ yaviṣṭho'mṛtavānapi .. 31.8 ..
1.31.d:
तुरीयो निर्हपुश्चैव युक्तो ग्रावाजिनस्तु ते।
यमिनो विश्वदेवाद्यं यविष्ठोऽमृतवानपि ॥ 31.8 ॥
1.31.m:
Turīya, Nirhapu, and Yuktagrāvājin—these
Yamin gods beginning with Viśvedeva, and Yaviṣṭha and Amṛtavat,

1.31.s:
ajiro vibhurvibhāvaśca mṛliko'tha didehakaḥ.
śrutiśrṛṇo bṛhacchukro devā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ .. 31.9 ..
1.31.d:
अजिरो विभुर्विभावश्च मृलिकोऽथ दिदेहकः।
श्रुतिश्रृणो बृहच्छुक्रो देवा द्वादश कीर्तिताः ॥ 31.9 ॥
1.31.m:
Ajira, Vibhu, Vibhāva, Mṛlika, then Didehaka,
Śrutiśṛṇa, Bṛhacchukra: twelve gods are proclaimed.

1.31.s:
āsan svāyambhuvasyaite antare somapāyinaḥ.
tviṣimanto gaṇā hyete vīryavanto mahābalāḥ .. 31.10 ..
1.31.d:
आसन् स्वायम्भुवस्यैते अन्तरे सोमपायिनः।
त्विषिमन्तो गणा ह्येते वीर्यवन्तो महाबलाः ॥ 31.10 ॥
1.31.m:
These were the Soma-drinkers in the cosmic age of Svāyambhuva.
These groups were radiant, valiant, and possessed of great strength.

1.31.s:
teṣāmindraḥ sadā hyāsīdviśvabhuk prathamo vibhuḥ.
asurā yetadā teṣāmāsan dāyādabāndhavāḥ .. 31.11 ..
1.31.d:
तेषामिन्द्रः सदा ह्यासीद्विश्वभुक् प्रथमो विभुः।
असुरा येतदा तेषामासन् दायादबान्धवाः ॥ 31.11 ॥
1.31.m:
Their Indra was always the first all-devouring lord.
The asuras who existed then were their kinsmen and co-heirs.

1.31.s:
suparṇayakṣagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ.
aṣṭau te pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ nāsatyā devayonayaḥ .. 31.12 ..
1.31.d:
सुपर्णयक्षगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः।
अष्टौ ते पितृभिः सार्द्धं नासत्या देवयोनयः ॥ 31.12 ॥
1.31.m:
The Suparṇas, yakṣas, gandharvas, piśācas, uragas, and rākṣasas,
those eight together with the ancestors and the two Nāsatyas are of divine origin.

1.31.s:
svāyambhuve'ntare'tītāḥ prajāstvāsāṃ sahasraśaḥ.
prabhāvarūpasampannā āyuṣā ca balena ca .. 31.13 ..
1.31.d:
स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरेऽतीताः प्रजास्त्वासां सहस्रशः।
प्रभावरूपसम्पन्ना आयुषा च बलेन च ॥ 31.13 ॥
1.31.m:
In the cosmic age of Svāyambhuva there passed thousands of their offspring,
endowed with splendour and beauty, and with longevity and strength.

1.31.s:
vistarādiha nocyante mā prasaṅgo bhavatviha.
svāyambhuvo nisargaśca vijñeyaḥ sāmprataṃ manuḥ .. 31.14 ..
1.31.d:
विस्तरादिह नोच्यन्ते मा प्रसङ्गो भवत्विह।
स्वायम्भुवो निसर्गश्च विज्ञेयः साम्प्रतं मनुः ॥ 31.14 ॥
1.31.m:
They are not spoken of here in detail, lest this discourse become too long.
The creation of Svāyambhuva Manu is to be understood at present.

1.31.s:
atīte varttamānena dṛṣṭo vaivasvatena saḥ.
prajābhirdevatābhiśca ṛṣibhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 31.15 ..
1.31.d:
अतीते वर्त्तमानेन दृष्टो वैवस्वतेन सः।
प्रजाभिर्देवताभिश्च ऋषिभिः पितृभिः सह ॥ 31.15 ॥
1.31.m:
Having passed away, it was perceived in the present by Vaivasvata,
together with his subjects, deities, seers, and ancestors.

1.31.s:
teṣāṃ saptarṣayaḥ pūrvamāsanye tān nibodhata.
bhṛgvaṅgirā marīciśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ .. 31.16 ..
1.31.d:
तेषां सप्तर्षयः पूर्वमासन्ये तान् निबोधत।
भृग्वङ्गिरा मरीचिश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ॥ 31.16 ॥
1.31.m:
Learn of those who were their seven seers in the beginning:
Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Marīci, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu,

1.31.s:
atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca sapta svāyambhuve'ntare.
agnīdhraścātibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ .. 31.17 ..
1.31.d:
अत्रिश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च सप्त स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे।
अग्नीध्रश्चातिबाहुश्च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः ॥ 31.17 ॥
1.31.m: And Atri and Vasiṣṭha—these are the seven in the interval of Svāyambhuva. / Agnīdhra, Atibāhu, Medhā, Medhātithi, Vasu,

1.31.s: jyotiṣmān dyutimān havyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca ..
1.31.d: ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमान् हव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च ॥
1.31.m: Jyotiṣmat, Dyutimat, Havya, Savana, and Putra— / these were the ten sons of Svāyambhuva Manu, endowed with great energy.

1.31.s: manoḥ svāyambhuvasyaite daśa putrā mahaujasaḥ .. 31.18 ..
1.31.d: मनोः स्वायम्भुवस्यैते दश पुत्रा महौजसः ॥ 31.18 ॥

1.31.s:
vāyuproktā mahāsattvā rājānaḥ prathame'ntare.
sāsurantatsagandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam.
sapiśācamanuṣyañca suparṇāpsarasāṅgaṇam .. 31.19 ..
1.31.d:
वायुप्रोक्ता महासत्त्वा राजानः प्रथमेऽन्तरे।
सासुरन्तत्सगन्धर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम्।
सपिशाचमनुष्यञ्च सुपर्णाप्सरसाङ्गणम् ॥ 31.19 ॥
1.31.m: Declared by Vāyu, these kings in the first interval were of great strength. / With asuras, gandharvas, yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas, / with piśācas, humans, and hosts of suparṇas and apsarases,

1.31.s:
no śakyamānupūrvyeṇa vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi.
bahutvānnāmadheyānāṃ saṅkhyā teṣāṃ kule tathā .. 31.20 ..
1.31.d:
नो शक्यमानुपूर्व्येण वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि।
बहुत्वान्नामधेयानां सङ्ख्या तेषां कुले तथा ॥ 31.20 ॥
1.31.m: it is impossible to recount them in order even in hundreds of years, / because of the multitude of names and their count within the family.

1.31.s:
yā vai vrajakulākhyāstu āsan svāyambuve'ntare.
kālena bahunātītā ayanābdayugakramaiḥ .. 31.21 ..
1.31.d:
या वै व्रजकुलाख्यास्तु आसन् स्वायम्बुवेऽन्तरे।
कालेन बहुनातीता अयनाब्दयुगक्रमैः ॥ 31.21 ॥
1.31.m: The lineages of communities that existed in the interval of Svāyambhuva / have long since passed away through the cycles of half-years, years, and yugas.

1.31.s: ..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
1.31.d: ॥ऋषय ऊचुः॥
1.31.m:
The seers said:
Who is this divine Time, the destroyer of all beings? / From what is he born, what is his origin, what is his true nature, whose son is he?

1.31.s:
ka eṣa bhagavān kālaḥ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ.
kasya yoniḥ kimādiśca kintattvaṃ sa kimātmajaḥ .. 31.22 ..
1.31.d:
क एष भगवान् कालः सर्वभूतापहारकः।
कस्य योनिः किमादिश्च किन्तत्त्वं स किमात्मजः ॥ 31.22 ॥

1.31.s:
kimasya cakṣuḥ kā mūrtiḥ ke cāsyāvayavāḥ smṛtāḥ.
kiṃnāmadheyaḥ ko'syātmā etat prabrūhi pṛcchatām .. 31.23 ..
1.31.d:
किमस्य चक्षुः का मूर्तिः के चास्यावयवाः स्मृताः।
किंनामधेयः कोऽस्यात्मा एतत् प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम् ॥ 31.23 ॥
1.31.m: What is his eye, what is his form, and what are said to be his limbs? / What is his name, and what is his soul? Explain this to us as we ask.”

1.31.s: ..sūta uvāca..
1.31.d: ॥सूत उवाच॥
1.31.m:
The Sūta said:
Let the true nature of Time be heard, and having heard, let it be comprehended: / having the sun as his source, beginning with a twinkling of the eye, he is said to have calculation as his eye.

1.31.s:
śrūyatāṃ kālasadbhāvaḥ śrutvā caivāvadhāryatām.
sūryayonirnimeṣādiḥ saṅkhyācakṣuḥ sa ucyate .. 31.24 ..
1.31.d:
श्रूयतां कालसद्भावः श्रुत्वा चैवावधार्यताम्।
सूर्ययोनिर्निमेषादिः सङ्ख्याचक्षुः स उच्यते ॥ 31.24 ॥

1.31.s:
mūrttirasya tvahorātre nimeṣāvayavaśca saḥ.
saṃvatsaraśataṃ tvasya nāma cāsya kalātmakam.
sāmpratānāgatātītakālātmā sa prajāpatiḥ .. 31.25 ..
1.31.d:
मूर्त्तिरस्य त्वहोरात्रे निमेषावयवश्च सः।
संवत्सरशतं त्वस्य नाम चास्य कलात्मकम्।
साम्प्रतानागतातीतकालात्मा स प्रजापतिः ॥ 31.25 ॥
1.31.m: His form is day and night, and the twinkling of an eye is his limb; / his name is a hundred years, and consists of kalās; / embodying present, future, and past time, he is Prajāpati.

1.31.s:
pañcānāṃ pravibhaktānāṃ kālāvasthāṃ nibhodhata.
dinārddhamāsamāsaistu ṛtubhistvayanaistathā .. 31.26 ..
1.31.d:
पञ्चानां प्रविभक्तानां कालावस्थां निभोधत।
दिनार्द्धमासमासैस्तु ऋतुभिस्त्वयनैस्तथा ॥ 31.26 ॥
1.31.m: Learn the state of Time divided into five parts: / by days, fortnights, months, seasons, and half-years.

1.31.s:
saṃvatsarastu prathamo dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ.
idvatsarastṛtīyastu caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ .. 31.27 ..
1.31.d:
संवत्सरस्तु प्रथमो द्वितीयः परिवत्सरः।
इद्वत्सरस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थश्चानुवत्सरः ॥ 31.27 ॥
1.31.m: The first is the Saṃvatsara, the second is the Parivatsara, / the third is the Idvatsara, and the fourth is the Anuvatsara;

1.31.s:
vatsaraḥ pañcamasteṣāṃ kālaḥ sa yugasaṃjñitaḥ.
teṣāntu tattvaṃ vakṣyāmi kīrttyamānaṃ nibodhata .. 31.28 ..
1.31.d:
वत्सरः पञ्चमस्तेषां कालः स युगसंज्ञितः।
तेषान्तु तत्त्वं वक्ष्यामि कीर्त्त्यमानं निबोधत ॥ 31.28 ॥
1.31.m: the fifth among them is the Vatsara; that is Time, known by the name of yuga. / I shall tell you their true nature as it is celebrated; listen.

1.31.s:
ṛturagnistu yaḥ proktaḥ sa tu saṃvatsaro mataḥ.
āditye yastvasau sāraḥ kālāgniḥ parivatsaraḥ .. 31.29 ..
1.31.d:
ऋतुरग्निस्तु यः प्रोक्तः स तु संवत्सरो मतः।
आदित्ये यस्त्वसौ सारः कालाग्निः परिवत्सरः ॥ 31.29 ॥
1.31.m: The fire that is declared to be the season is regarded as the Saṃvatsara. / The fire of time which is the essence in the sun is the Parivatsara.

1.31.s:
śuklakṛṣṇā gatiścāpi apāṃ sāramayaḥ khagaḥ.
sa iḍāvatsaraḥ somaḥ purāṇe niścayo mataḥ .. 31.30 ..
1.31.d:
शुक्लकृष्णा गतिश्चापि अपां सारमयः खगः।
स इडावत्सरः सोमः पुराणे निश्चयो मतः ॥ 31.30 ॥
1.31.m: The sky-travelling moon, whose course has light and dark [halves], consisting of the essence of water— / he is the Iḍāvatsara, Soma; such is the conclusion in the Purāṇa.

1.31.s:
yaścāyaṃ tapate lokāṃstanubhiḥ saptasaptabhiḥ.
āśukarttā ca lokasya savāyuriti vatsaraḥ .. 31.31 ..
1.31.d:
यश्चायं तपते लोकांस्तनुभिः सप्तसप्तभिः।
आशुकर्त्ता च लोकस्य सवायुरिति वत्सरः ॥ 31.31 ॥
1.31.m: And he who warms the worlds with his sevenfold bodies, / the swift actor of the world—he is the Vatsara, identical with Vāyu.

1.31.s:
ahaṅkārāt rudan rudraḥ sadbhūto brahmaṇastrayaḥ.
sa rudro vatsarasteṣāṃ vijajñe nīlalohitaḥ.
teṣāṃ hi tattvaṃ vakṣyāmi kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhata .. 31.32 ..
1.31.d:
अहङ्कारात् रुदन् रुद्रः सद्भूतो ब्रह्मणस्त्रयः।
स रुद्रो वत्सरस्तेषां विजज्ञे नीललोहितः।
तेषां हि तत्त्वं वक्ष्यामि कीर्त्यमानं निबोधत ॥ 31.32 ॥
1.31.m: Weeping out of egoity, Rudra arose as the triad of Brahmā; / that Rudra, dark-blue and red, was born as their Vatsara. / Indeed, I shall declare their true nature as it is proclaimed; listen.

1.31.s:
aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyogāt kālātmā prapitāmahaḥ.
ṛksāma yajuṣāṃ yoniḥ pañcānāṃ patirīśvaraḥ .. 31.33 ..
1.31.d:
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसंयोगात् कालात्मा प्रपितामहः।
ऋक्साम यजुषां योनिः पञ्चानां पतिरीश्वरः ॥ 31.33 ॥
1.31.m: Through the conjunction of limbs and minor limbs, the great-grandfather is the soul of Time; / the source of the Ṛg, Sāma, and Yajus, he is the Lord, master of the five.

1.31.s:
so'gniryajuśca somaśca sa bhūtaḥ sa prajāpatiḥ.
proktaḥ saṃvatsaraśceti sūryo yo'gnirmanīṣibhiḥ .. 31.34 ..
1.31.d:
सोऽग्निर्यजुश्च सोमश्च स भूतः स प्रजापतिः।
प्रोक्तः संवत्सरश्चेति सूर्यो योऽग्निर्मनीषिभिः ॥ 31.34 ॥
1.31.m: He is fire, the Yajus, and Soma; he is the bhūta, he is Prajāpati; / the sun, who is fire, is declared by the wise to be the Saṃvatsara.

1.31.s:
yasmāt kālavibhāgānāṃ māsartvayanayorapi.
grahanakṣatraśītoṣṇavarṣāyuḥkarmaṇāṃ tathā.
yojitaḥ pravibhāgānāṃ divasānāñca bhāskaraḥ .. 31.35 ..
1.31.d:
यस्मात् कालविभागानां मासर्त्वयनयोरपि।
ग्रहनक्षत्रशीतोष्णवर्षायुःकर्मणां तथा।
योजितः प्रविभागानां दिवसानाञ्च भास्करः ॥ 31.35 ॥
1.31.m: Because he is joined to the divisions of time—months, seasons, and half-years, / planets, lunar mansions, cold, heat, rain, life, and rituals— / the sun is the creator of the divisions of days.

1.31.s:
vaikārikaḥ prasannātmā brahmaputraḥ prajāpatiḥ.
ekenaiko'tha divaso māso'thartuḥ pitāmahaḥ .. 31.36 ..
1.31.d:
वैकारिकः प्रसन्नात्मा ब्रह्मपुत्रः प्रजापतिः।
एकेनैकोऽथ दिवसो मासोऽथर्तुः पितामहः ॥ 31.36 ॥
1.31.m: He is the product of modifications, serene-minded, the son of Brahmā, Prajāpati; / by one [division] after another, the grandfather is the day, month, and season.

1.31.s:
ādityaḥ savitā bhānurjīvano brahmasatkṛtaḥ.
prabhavaścātya yaścaiva bhūtānāṃ tena bhāskaraḥ .. 31.37 ..
1.31.d:
आदित्यः सविता भानुर्जीवनो ब्रह्मसत्कृतः।
प्रभवश्चात्य यश्चैव भूतानां तेन भास्करः ॥ 31.37 ॥
1.31.m: He is Āditya, Savitṛ, the sun, the life-giver honoured by Brahmā; / he is the source and the departure of beings; therefore he is the Illuminator.

1.31.s:
tārābhimānī vijñeyastṛtīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ.
somaḥ sarvauṣadhipatiryasmātsa prapitāmahaḥ .. 31.38 ..
1.31.d:
ताराभिमानी विज्ञेयस्तृतीयः परिवत्सरः।
सोमः सर्वौषधिपतिर्यस्मात्स प्रपितामहः ॥ 31.38 ॥
1.31.m: Presiding over the stars, the third is known as Parivatsara: / Soma, lord of all medicinal herbs, because he is the great-grandfather.

1.31.s:
ājīvaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemakṛdīśvaraḥ.
avekṣaṇāṇaḥ satataṃ bibharti jagadaṃśubhiḥ .. 31.39 ..
1.31.d:
आजीवः सर्वभूतानां योगक्षेमकृदीश्वरः।
अवेक्षणाणः सततं बिभर्ति जगदंशुभिः ॥ 31.39 ॥
1.31.m: He is the sustenance of all beings, the Lord who brings security and prosperity; / watching continually, he maintains the world with his rays.

1.31.s:
tithīnāṃ parvasandhīnāṃ pūrṇimādarśayorapi.
yonirniśākaro yaśca yo'mṛtātmā prajāpatiḥ .. 31.40 ..
1.31.d:
तिथीनां पर्वसन्धीनां पूर्णिमादर्शयोरपि।
योनिर्निशाकरो यश्च योऽमृतात्मा प्रजापतिः ॥ 31.40 ॥
1.31.m: He is the origin of lunar days, nodal transitions, full moons, and new moons, / the night-maker, Prajāpati whose self is nectar.

1.31.s:
tasmāt sa pitṛmān soma ṛgyajuśchandaātmakaḥ.
prāṇāpānasamānādyairvyānodānātmakairapi .. 31.41 ..
1.31.d:
तस्मात् स पितृमान् सोम ऋग्यजुश्छन्दआत्मकः।
प्राणापानसमानाद्यैर्व्यानोदानात्मकैरपि ॥ 31.41 ॥
1.31.m: Therefore he is Soma, associated with the ancestors, consisting of Ṛc, Yajus, and meters. / Through prāṇa, apāna, samāna, and so forth, as well as vyāna and udāna,

1.31.s:
karmabhiḥ prāṇināṃ loke sarvaceṣṭāpravarttakaḥ.
prāṇāpānasamānānāṃ vāyūnāñca pravarttakaḥ .. 31.42 ..
1.31.d:
कर्मभिः प्राणिनां लोके सर्वचेष्टाप्रवर्त्तकः।
प्राणापानसमानानां वायूनाञ्च प्रवर्त्तकः ॥ 31.42 ॥
1.31.m: he is the initiator of all activity through the actions of living beings in the world, / the impeller of the vital winds—prāṇa, apāna, and samāna—

1.31.s:
pañcānāñcendriyamanobuddhismṛti jalātmanām.
samānakālakaraṇaḥ kriyāḥ sampādayanniva .. 31.43 ..
1.31.d:
पञ्चानाञ्चेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिस्मृति जलात्मनाम्।
समानकालकरणः क्रियाः सम्पादयन्निव ॥ 31.43 ॥
1.31.m: and of the five senses, mind, intellect, memory, and water-souls, / effecting actions simultaneously, as it were, while accomplishing them;

1.31.s:
sarvātmā sarvalokānāmāvahaḥ pravahādibhiḥ.
vidhātā sarvabhūtānāṃ kṣamī nityaṃ prabhañjanaḥ .. 31.44 ..
1.31.d:
सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकानामावहः प्रवहादिभिः।
विधाता सर्वभूतानां क्षमी नित्यं प्रभञ्जनः ॥ 31.44 ॥
1.31.m: the soul of all, of all worlds, through the winds Avaha, Pravaha, and others, / the creator of all beings, always forbearing, Prabhañcana;

1.31.s:
yoniragnerapāṃ bhūme raveścandramasaścayaḥ.
vāyuḥ prajāpirbhūtaṃ lokātmā prapitāmahaḥ .. 31.45 ..
1.31.d:
योनिरग्नेरपां भूमे रवेश्चन्द्रमसश्चयः।
वायुः प्रजापिर्भूतं लोकात्मा प्रपितामहः ॥ 31.45 ॥
1.31.m: the womb of fire, water, earth, the sun, and the moon, / Vāyu, Prajāpati, the element, the soul of the world, the great-grandfather.

1.31.s:
prajāpati mukhairdevaiḥ samyagiṣṭaphalārthibhiḥ.
tribhireva kapālaistu ambakairoṣadhikṣaye.
ijyate bhagavān yasmāttasmāt tryambaka ucyate .. 31.46 ..
1.31.d:
प्रजापति मुखैर्देवैः सम्यगिष्टफलार्थिभिः।
त्रिभिरेव कपालैस्तु अम्बकैरोषधिक्षये।
इज्यते भगवान् यस्मात्तस्मात् त्र्यम्बक उच्यते ॥ 31.46 ॥
1.31.m: Because the Lord is worshipped with three potsherds / by the gods headed by Prajāpati desirous of properly attained fruits, / using sacrificial cakes at the destruction of herbs, he is called Tryambaka.

1.31.s:
gāyatrī caiva triṣṭup ca jagatī caiva yā smṛtā.
tryambakā nāmataḥ proktā yonayaḥ savanasya tāḥ .. 31.47 ..
1.31.d:
गायत्री चैव त्रिष्टुप् च जगती चैव या स्मृता।
त्र्यम्बका नामतः प्रोक्ता योनयः सवनस्य ताः ॥ 31.47 ॥
1.31.m: Gāyatrī, Triṣṭubh, and Jagatī, as they are known, / are called the Tryambakas, the sources of the soma-pressing.

1.31.s:
tābhirekatvabhūtābhistrividhābhiḥ svavīryataḥ.
trisādhanapuroḍāśastri kapālaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .. 31.48 ..
1.31.d:
ताभिरेकत्वभूताभिस्त्रिविधाभिः स्ववीर्यतः।
त्रिसाधनपुरोडाशस्त्रि कपालः स वै स्मृतः ॥ 31.48 ॥
1.31.m: Through them, united into one threefold entity by their own potency, / he is known as the three-potsherd cake possessing three means.

1.31.s:
ityetatpañcavarṣaṃ hi yugaṃ proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ.
yaccaiva pañcadhātmā vai proktaḥ saṃvatsaro dvijaiḥ.
saikaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ vijajñe'tha madhvādīnṛtavaḥkila .. 31.49 ..
1.31.d:
इत्येतत्पञ्चवर्षं हि युगं प्रोक्तं मनीषिभिः।
यच्चैव पञ्चधात्मा वै प्रोक्तः संवत्सरो द्विजैः।
सैकं षट्कं विजज्ञेऽथ मध्वादीनृतवःकिल ॥ 31.49 ॥
1.31.m: Thus this five-year period is called a yuga by the wise. / And because the year is declared fivefold in nature by the twice-born, / with one added to six, it brought forth the seasons beginning with Madhu.

1.31.s:
ṛtuputrārttavaḥ pañca iti sargaḥ samāsataḥ.
ityeṣa pavamāno vai prāṇināṃ jīvitāni tu .. 31.50 ..
1.31.d:
ऋतुपुत्रार्त्तवः पञ्च इति सर्गः समासतः।
इत्येष पवमानो वै प्राणिनां जीवितानि तु ॥ 31.50 ॥
1.31.m: The sons of the seasons are the five seasonal periods; thus is creation in brief. / In this way, this purifying wind sweeps away the lives of living beings;

1.31.s:
nadī vegasamāyuktaṃ kālo dhāvati saṃharan.
ahorātrakarastasmāt sa vāyurabhavatpunaḥ .. 31.51 ..
1.31.d:
नदी वेगसमायुक्तं कालो धावति संहरन्।
अहोरात्रकरस्तस्मात् स वायुरभवत्पुनः ॥ 31.51 ॥
1.31.m: with the speed of a river, Time rushes on, destroying; / from this, Vāyu again became the maker of day and night.

1.31.s:
ete prajānāṃ patayaḥ pradhānāḥ sarvadehinām .
pitaraḥ sarva lokānāṃ lokātmānaḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 31.52 ..
1.31.d:
एते प्रजानां पतयः प्रधानाः सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
पितरः सर्व लोकानां लोकात्मानः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 31.52 ॥
1.31.m: These are the lords of creatures, the foremost of all embodied beings, / the fathers of all the worlds, celebrated as the souls of the world.

1.31.s:
dhyāyato brahmaṇo vakrādudyan samabhavadbhavaḥ.
ṛṣirvipro mahādevo bhūtātmā prapitāmahaḥ .. 31.53 ..
1.31.d:
ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणो वक्रादुद्यन् समभवद्भवः।
ऋषिर्विप्रो महादेवो भूतात्मा प्रपितामहः ॥ 31.53 ॥
1.31.m: As Brahmā was meditating, Bhava arose emerging from his mouth: / the seer, the sage, Mahādeva, the soul of beings, the great-grandfather,

1.31.s:
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ praṇavāyopapadyate.
ātmaveśena bhūtānāmaṅgapratyaṅgasambhavaḥ .. 31.54 ..
1.31.d:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां प्रणवायोपपद्यते।
आत्मवेशेन भूतानामङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्भवः ॥ 31.54 ॥
1.31.m: the Lord of all beings, who is realized through the Praṇava; / through entering beings by himself, he causes the generation of limbs and minor limbs.

1.31.s:
agniḥ saṃvatsaraḥ sūryaścandramā vāyureva ca.
yugābhimānī kālātmā nityaṃ saṃkṣepakṛdvibhuḥ.
unmādako'nugrahakṛtsa idvatsara ucyate .. 31.55 ..
1.31.d:
अग्निः संवत्सरः सूर्यश्चन्द्रमा वायुरेव च।
युगाभिमानी कालात्मा नित्यं संक्षेपकृद्विभुः।
उन्मादकोऽनुग्रहकृत्स इद्वत्सर उच्यते ॥ 31.55 ॥
1.31.m: Agni, the Saṃvatsara, the sun, the moon, and Vāyu— / presiding over the yuga, the soul of Time, the all-pervading who constantly brings about compression, / bewildering and conferring grace, he is called the Idvatsara.

1.31.s:
rudrāviṣṭo bhagavatā jagatyasmin svatejasā.
āśrayāśrayasaṃyogāttanubhirnāmabhistathā .. 31.56 ..
1.31.d:
रुद्राविष्टो भगवता जगत्यस्मिन् स्वतेजसा।
आश्रयाश्रयसंयोगात्तनुभिर्नामभिस्तथा ॥ 31.56 ॥
